title: Postdoc Positions within Mobile Robotics at SDU Robotics
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within mobile robotics. We therefore invite applications for one or more postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to the mobile robotics lab specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automated agriculture as well as related applications that require mobility in open terrain. We expect that the research activities involve both computer vision for scene understanding, tracking of relevant artefacts, as well as the integration and development of AI-based solutions for autonomous operation in scenarios within, e.g., field processing. The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in testing facilities at SDU as well as project partners and head the evaluation efforts in collaboration with a consortium of interdisciplinary project partners. 

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching and supervision responsibilities could also be part of employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Participation in ongoing and future research projects.

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to mobile robots controlled with multimodal feedback. The candidates are hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge with ROS2 and relevant modules such as the Nav2

  • Strong knowledge in multi-object tracking

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design, development and integration of robotic systems

Furthermore, the successful candidates are expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

Research environment

The candidates will be integrated in the unit SDU Robotics. We are a team of approximately 60 researchers and engineers based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in welfare, industrial automation, lab automation, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics. 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Associate Professor Leon Bodenhagen lebo@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Verified copies of official certificates/diplomas and transcripts of exams (MSc and PhD), both the original documents and in professional English translation.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position, may also be included. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

Employment terms

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

This postdoc position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

title: Software Engineer for Centre for Software Technology (CST)
description:
Centre for Software Technology (CST), part of the Software Engineering units at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, located in Vejle, invites applications for an engineering position to support the buildup of the Centre and supporting laboratories. The centre is a newly started center that focuses on software engineering, interaction technology and AI research and education in close cooperation with companies to utilize the potential in digitalization. It is expected that the centre will experience a significant growth over the next five years.

The Centre for Software Technology (CST) at SDU is a part of the new campus, SDU Vejle, home of excellence within information technology. The academic focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is to conduct research in interactive information technology and software engineering. The areas will be complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The centre is involved in a variety of research and collaboration projects nationally and internationally. The centre has a strong collaboration with industry to solve challenging research problems from real applications, and to participate in implementing the achieved results into real solutions with end users. The work in the centre is structured around a number of laboratories.

The work and responsibilities for the applicant will be within the areas of:

  • Prototyping interactive technologies such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, circuits, microcontrollers, soldering, sensors, and actuators

  • Software development in relation to advanced interaction technologies, intelligent systems, cyber-physical systems, e.g. in the areas of critical infrastructure and healthcare systems

  • Developing and maintaining infrastructures to support the laboratories in close collaboration with the associated researchers

  • Support for research and educational activities

  • Managing lab space including inventory, supplies and materials, space maintenance and organization, developing and enforcing safety procedures, providing and managing training for specialized fabrication equipment

  • Digital/physical fabrication with laser cutters, 3D printers, 3D modeling, making enclosures for interactive electronics, making professional robust physical artifacts

  • Facilitating and participation in business development in collaboration with local industry and municipality

  • Using AI technologies effectively, ethically and systematically in the context of engineering applications 

The applicant we are looking for should have one or more of the following competencies:

  • Experience with collaboration projects that involve industry and academia

  • Experience with implementing software solutions in a variety of programming languages

  • Experience with managing a lab space including managing training for specialized fabrication equipment.

  • Experience with prototyping interactive technologies and digital/physical fabrication

  • Experience with software development processes and methods

  • Experience with infrastructures to support software development (e.g. Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud infrastructures)

  • Experience with the development of middleware, services, micro services, and databases

  • Experience with Generative AI and Prompt Engineering, e.g. tailoring effective prompts to instruct LLMs; knowing the dos and don’ts of GenAI from ethical angles 

  • Experience with data engineering including the use of machine learning frameworks with software such as PyTorch and TensorFlow

It is expected that the candidate has documented qualifications related to the position, for example, shown by a degree in the field of software engineering, interaction technologies, computer engineering, computer science or similar or previous related job positions.

A candidate should be able to achieve a Danish security clearance to take part in the development of critical technology.

We offer a dynamic and diverse work environment with a large variety of tasks, and you will be given the opportunity to work on different research projects applying your skills within the software domain. It is expected that you can work in a team, but also solve your tasks independently.

Further information is available from LEGO® Chair and Professor Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard, mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk, +45 2197 2447.

Application deadline is November 22, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).  

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary and employment terms

The position is available from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The position is full-time. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

  • Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

  • Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

  • Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

  • Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

  • Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

  • Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

title: Hoist Operators
description:
Expression of interest

Offshore Helicopter Hoist Operators – Supporting the Green Energy Sector

Join Our Hoist Operator Pool for Future Opportunities

At Avincis, we are proud to support the green energy transition by providing safe and efficient helicopter transport to offshore wind farms and associated installations.

As the offshore wind industry continues to grow, we are preparing for potential future expansion of our operations in Denmark and Northern Germany. We are therefore interested in connecting with experienced Hoist Operators who may wish to join our team as new opportunities arise.

---

Please note that this is not an active vacancy. We are building a network of qualified Hoist Operators who may be interested in future opportunities within our operations. Candidates whose qualifications and experience match our requirements may be contacted as suitable positions become available.

  

About the Role

As a Hoist Operator at Avincis Aviation Denmark, you will be part of a professional crew operating Airbus H135/H145 helicopters to support offshore wind operations. You will play a key role in supporting offshore operations. Missions include precision hoisting to offshore turbines, vessels, and substations.

Who we are Looking for

Minimum qualifications:

  • Physically and mentally fit

  • Can pass EASA Class 2 medical

  • English Speaking

  • Must be a safety minded person

  • You enjoy working as a part of a team.

Highly desirable experience:

  • Residence in Denmark or nearby region

  • Scandinavian speaking

  • Experience as a Hoist Operator, or under education as a pilot.

 

Why Join Avincis Aviation Denmark?

  • Be part of a mission-driven company contributing directly to the green energy transition

  • Operate modern aircraft in a well-established and safety-focused organization

  • Work in a dedicated team that values professionalism, adaptability, and collaboration

  • Be part of a strong team spirit in a dynamic and high-performing work environment

 

About Avincis Aviation Denmark

Avincis Aviation Denmark delivers specialized helicopter solutions to the offshore wind sector – a rapidly growing industry at the forefront of the climate challenge. We offer flexible, reliable and safe transport of crews and equipment to wind farms and vessels in among others the North Sea and in the waters around Denmark.

With a track record of operational excellence and close partnerships with key players in the wind industry, we are proud to be part of building a sustainable energy future.

How to Apply

Please upload CV, relevant licenses and certificates.  Danish and English written applications are accepted.

Candidates meeting the qualification requirements may be invited to provide additional documentation regarding aeronautical experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and retained for consideration in connection with future recruitment processes.

Avincis Aviation Denmark A/S is committed to equal opportunities and evaluates all applications fairly and objectively, regardless of gender or background.

Your data will be handled confidentially in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR). For further details, please refer to our privacy policy or contact us at the email above.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaverSom restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse•    Mulighed for bolig•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og CV til smag@smag-toscana.dk

Ansøgning mærkes i emnefeltet: Restaurationsmanager

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant. Your responsibilities will include:•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment•    Accommodation available•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working HoursWorking hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will appoint the right candidate as soon as they are found.

We look forward to hearing from you

Me ei anna Sulle ainult töökoha vaid aitame Sul ka kliente leida. Sind ootab ees tõeline sotsiaalmeedia turunduskoolitus! 💪 Toimiv süsteem, kogemus! Ilustuudio Mariell on tegev olnud juba 11 aastat - meil on salong ka Tartus ja 4 tükki Tallinnas. 🕐 24/7 ligipääs ruumidele! 💉Tervisesõbralikkus - kõik meie salongid on ehitatud vastavalt terviseameti nõuetele, et Su tervis oleks hoitud! 💃Meeskond - ettevõtlus ei ole pelgalt raha teenimine. A formal degree or technical diploma is not required. Practical skills, experience, and the ability to solve real technical problems matter most. Additional Advantages Experience repairing automotive electronic modules (ECUs, instrument clusters, amplifiers). Knowledge of industrial electronics and automation. BGA rework skills. Experience with specialized or unusual electronic equipment.

Kui sulle meeldib oma kätega midagi erilist luua, hindad häid tööriistu ja tahad näha oma töö üle uhkust tundmist väärt tulemust, siis meie juures on sul selleks kõik võimalused!

Tehniliselt taiplikku ja leidlikku – oskad iseseisvalt mõelda, probleeme lahendada ja vajadusel nutikaid lahendusi välja töötada. Kannatlikku ja järjekindlat – mõistad, et kvaliteetne taastamistöö nõuab aega, pühendumist ja täpsust. Iseseisvat ja vastutustundlikku – oskad oma tööd planeerida, võtad vastutuse tulemuse eest ja pead kokkulepetest kinni. Õpihimulist ja arenemissooviga – tunned huvi uute töövõtete vastu ja soovid oma meisterlikkust pidevalt täiendada. Positiivset ja meeskonnahingega – oled sõbralik, koostööaldis ja aitad kaasa heale töökeskkonnale. Kõige olulisem on, et sul oleks tõeline huvi autode taastamise ja plekitöö vastu, head käelised oskused ning soov teha tööd, mille üle saad ise uhkust tunda.

title: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!
description: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!Oletko ihmisläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy ravintoloiden arjessa, innostuu asioiden järjestämisestä ja uskaltaa tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin? Meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!Factorylla on 28 ravintolaa Helsingissä, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Salossa, Hämeenlinnassa ja Lahdessaja kasvumme jatkuu!Meillä työskentelee paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus ovat tärkeä osa Factorya.Nyt etsimme HR-tiimiimme uutta työkaveria tukemaan henkilöstömme ja ravintoloidemme arkea.Meillä henkilöstötyötä tehdään lähellä ihmisiä: ravintoloissa, esihenkilöiden rinnalla ja yhdessä monikulttuurisen työyhteisömme kanssa.Päiviin mahtuu kohtaamisia, käytännön järjestelyjä, uuden ideointia ja yhdessä onnistumisen iloa.Millaista arkea sinulle olisi luvassa?Olet tärkeä tuki ravintoloidemme esihenkilöille niin päivittäisissä kysymyksissä kuin haastavammissakin henkilöstötilanteissa.Työhösi kuuluu:- Esihenkilöiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjessa: kuuntelemista, neuvomista ja käytännön ravintolatilanteiden ratkomista yhdessä.- Innostavaa rekrytointia, jossa Factoryn työkulttuuri pääsee näkyviin, sekä perehdyttämistä ja uusien työntekijöiden tukemista, jotta he tuntevat itsensä tervetulleiksi ja pääsevät sujuvasti osaksi työyhteisöä.- Toimipistekierroksia ja henkilöstön kohtaamista ravintoloiden arjessa. Hahmotat toiminnan kokonaisuuden, ymmärrät työhön kohdistuvat odotukset ja asiakkaan polun sekä tartut reippaasti havaittuihin kehityskohteisiin yhdessä henkilöstön ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.- Uusien ravintoloiden avausten valmistelua ja avauksissa mukana olemista, henkilöstön perehdyttämistä sekä päivittäisen työohjelman ja arjen toimintatapojen rakentamista. Luoden hyvää työilmapiiriä ja yhteistä Factoryn toimintakulttuuria.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstötarpeiden ennakoinnissa, työntekijöiden koordinoinnissa toimipisteiden välillä sekä lomien ja sijaistusten järjestelyissä.- Työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvien asioiden hoitamista, työsopimusten huolellista valmistelua sekä henkilöstötietojen tarkkaa ja ajantasaista ylläpitoa eri järjestelmissä.Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu työnteko-oikeuden ja oleskelulupien tarkistamista.- Henkilöstöviestintää, aktiivista kommunikointia ja ohjeistusten päivittämistä. Varmistat, että tieto kulkee ja ohjeet ymmärretään huomioimalla ihmisten erilaiset oppimistavat ja tuen tarpeet.- Tiivistä yhteistyötä palkanlaskennan kanssa, palkkoihin liittyvien kysymysten selvittämistä sekä molemminpuolista tukea ja apua arjen työtehtävissä.- Työkyvyn ja työhyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista varhaisen tuen keskusteluissa. Meille välitön välittäminen tarkoittaa huolten huomaamista, kuuntelemista ja tuen tarjoamista ajoissa.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstön johtamisessa, nopeaa reagointia arjen tilanteisiin sekä vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottamista. Tässä tarvitaan taitoa kuunnella, rohkeutta keskustella ja halua löytää ratkaisuja.- Koulutusten ja harjoittelujen koordinointia sekä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijämme saavat mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta, kehittyä ja edetä urallaan.- Yhteistyötä kumppaneidemme, kuten oppilaitosten ja työterveyshuollon, kanssa. Huolehdit avoimesta yhteydenpidosta ja sujuvasta yhteistyöstä, jotta asiat etenevät ja tuki tavoittaa oikeat ihmiset.- HR-käytäntöjen ideointia ja kehittämistä, jotta arki pysyy sujuvana ja toimintatapamme kehittyvät yrityksen kasvun mukana.Kaiken keskiössä ovat ihmiset ja arjen sujuminen. Tehtävässä pääset sekä suunnittelemaan että tarttumaan käytännön tekemiseen, oman tiimin tuella.Millainen työkaveri sopisi meidän HR-tiimiin?Toivomme, että olet helposti lähestyttävä, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava.Pidät monta lankaa käsissäsi ja kohtaat ihmiset lämpimästi myös kiireen keskellä. Innostut uusista asioista ja tuot rohkeasti omia ideoitasi esiin.Teet töitä pilke silmäkulmassa ja tuot huumorillasi hyvää fiilistä arkeen!Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, sillä saat tiimiltämme tukea työtehtäviisi.Tehtävässä tarvitset:- Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta oppia käyttämään erilaisia HR- ja rekrytointijärjestelmiä.- Erinomaista suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, ilmaiset itseäsi sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti molemmilla kielillä.- Oman auton ja ajokortin, sillä työ sisältää liikkumista toimipisteidemme välillä.- Valmiutta ja joustavuutta työskennellä pääsääntöisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä tehdä käyntejä ja yrityksen laajentuessa työskennellä myös sen ulkopuolella.- Ravintolan toimintatapojen tuntemusta ja valmiutta perehdyttää työntekijöitä. Ravintola-alan työkokemus on meille ehdoton plussa!- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hienotunteisuutta henkilöstöasioiden käsittelyssä.- Aikaisempi kokemus tiimin johtamisesta ja kokonaisuuden hallinnasta.Mitä saat meiltä?- Rempseän työtiimin, jossa saat kysyä, olla oma itsesi ja ratkoa asioita yhdessä.- Kokeneita, pitkään talossa olleita työkavereita sekä perehdytystä ja tukea työtehtäviisi.- Joustavan työajan ja pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuihin painottuvan työn. Mahdollisuuden tehdä satunnaisesti etätöitä.- Monipuolisen tehtävän jatkuvasti kasvavassa ravintolayrityksessä.- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja ideoida toimintatapojamme sekä edetä urallasi.- Työn, jossa oman tekemisesi vaikutus näkyy ihmisten ja ravintoloiden arjessa.- Toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Pitäjänmäellä. Työskentelet sekä toimistolla että ravintoloissamme.Etsimme pitkäaikaista työkaveria ja toivomme, että viihdyt meillä pitkään. Olisitko sinä sopiva meidän HR-tiimiimme?Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!Lähetä persoonallinen hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoiveineen.Kerro meille, kuka olet, osaamisesi ja mikä sinua innostaa työssä Factoryn HR-tiimissä.Haku on avoinna toistaiseksi.Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian!

title: Lähihoitaja lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun
description: Tervetuloa Onnin lapsiperheiden kotipalveluun!----------------------------------------Etsimme joukkoomme lämminhenkisiä ja reippaalla palveluasenteella varustettuja lähihoitajia sekä lastenhoitajia.Onnin lapsiperhepalveluissa olet perheiden tuki ja apu arjessa ja työskentelet perheen kotona itsenäisesti palveluperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Työtehtäviisi sisältyy perheen tarpeiden mukaisesti esim. kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, lastenhoitoa ja muita perhettä tukevia toimia. Voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi, ja työskennellä elämäntilanteeseesi parhaiten sopivalla tavalla! Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta kotiin vietävistä palveluista.Arvomme ystävällisyys, joustavuus ja luotettavuus näkyvät päivittäisessä työssämme.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatissasi. Onnilaisten rempseä tiimi jakaa arjen kanssasi ja toimii tukenasi.Maksamme sinulle kokemusvuosiesi perusteella 15,51 €/h - 16,92€/h + Tes-lisät + 9% lomakorvausKuulumme kotimaiseen Tradeka-konserniin, ja tarjoamme onnilaisille kattavia etuja, kuten:Alennuksia Restelin ravintoloissa.Tehtävään valitun henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.Odotamme jo hakemustasi! Ole yhteydessä rohkeasti tiimiesihenkilöKatja Lahtiseen katja.lahtinen@onnion.fi [katja.lahtinen@onnion.fi] tai hae helposti viimeistään 29.11 . mennessä.Tutustu tarkemmin henkilöstöetuihin ja Onniin työnantajana täällä: https://www.onnion.fi/rekrytointi/ [https://www.onnion.fi/rekrytointi/]----------------------------------------Tehtävä kuuluu työtehtäviin, joissa työnantajalla on yksityisyyden suojasta työelämässä annetun lain (759/2004) mukaisin edellytyksin mahdollisuus pyytää tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä huumausainetestiä koskeva todistus.

title: Technical Property Manager, Marine & Ports
description: At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You will be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.**This position reports to:**LD Manager & LBL Manager\_\_We are looking for a **Technical Property Manager** to take overall responsibility for the technical condition, maintenance and long-term development of our Marine & Ports facilities in Finland. In this role, you will ensure that our facilities are safe, reliable, energy-efficient and fit for purpose, while acting as the key technical expert for management and employees. Our facilities include manufacturing, warehouse and office space in 3 buildings in Helsinki, Hamina and Raisio, totalling over 30000 m2. The position is based in Vuosaari, Helsinki, and requires working from the office almost daily.In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact on the safety, reliability, sustainability and long-term development of our Marine working environment in Finland.**You will be mainly accountable for:**- Manage the maintenance and technical lifecycle of the facilities and building systems. - Plan and supervise maintenance, repairs, renovations and technical investments, including budgets, schedules, quality and costs. - Ensure reliable operation of HVAC, electrical, building automation, fire safety, access control, security and other technical systems. - Develop and maintain long-term maintenance and investment plans (PTS). - Manage facility service providers, contractors and related technical service agreements. - Ensure compliance with statutory inspections, authority requirements, safety standards and environmental requirements. - Drive energy-efficiency and sustainability improvements, including activities related to ISO 50001. - Coordinate contractors, work permits, site inductions and acceptance of completed works. - Acting as project manager for smaller upcoming business needs - Act as the technical point of contact for management, employees, landlords, authorities and external partners. **Qualifications for the Role**- Relevant education and several years of experience in property management, building services, construction engineering or a related technical field. - Strong knowledge of building systems, technical maintenance and facility lifecycle management. - Experience in contractor management, procurement, budgeting and project supervision. - Understanding of energy efficiency and relevant standards, such as ISO 50001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 27001. - Strong safety mindset and good collaboration and communication skills. - Willingness to travel regularly to the Hamina and Raisio sites, approximately 20-30 days per year. - Ability to work independently and take ownership of both day-to-day operations and long-term facility development. - Fluency in Finnish and professional working proficiency in English **More about us**At ABB Marine & Ports, we are committed to transforming our customers' vessels and terminal operations with innovative electric, automated, and digital technologies. As part of enabling a low-carbon society, we strive to preserve resources and promote social progress. Our sustainable solutions have a far-reaching impact, and by joining us you will actively play a part in contributing to a more sustainable future. www.abb.com/newsWe offer an international and dynamic working environment where our business delivers advanced technology in large projects across the world in a customer-oriented and highly globalized industry.Our culture and benefits reflect our values: courage, care, curiosity and collaboration. The most appreciated benefits according to our personnel are at the moment e.g. an annual performance bonus, employee share acquisition program, continuous learning opportunities, and other wellbeing and family benefits.For more information, please contact Local Division Manager Timo Marttinen +358 50 3323243. Best available on Friday 6.11. between 12:30-13:30, Monday 9.11. between 14-15, Friday 13.11. between 15-16. Interested in joining the crew? Please apply for the position by November 18, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application.#ABBCareers#RunwithABB#Runwhatrunstheworld _\- Work model: onsite, LI#onsite_Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.Ready to make an impact?Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Mekaaninen asentaja teollisuuden kunnossapitoon - Bewi Sastamala
description: [https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/3b87eccf-4db9-2ce7-4116-3535657a6b7d/original.png]MEKAANINEN ASENTAJA TEOLLISUUDEN KUNNOSSAPITOONTULE RAKENTAMAAN UUDEN TUOTANTOMME KUNNOSSAPITOA SASTAMALAANEtsimme mekaanisiin kunnossapitotehtäviin painottuvaa kunnossapitoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen BEWI:n kasvavaan kunnossapitotiimiin Sastamalaan. Pääset mukaan uusien tuotantolaitteiden asennuksiin ja käyttöönottoon sekä niiden pitkäaikaiseen kunnossapitoon. Työ on ainakin alkuvaiheessa päivätyötä. Tehtävässä edellytetään kuitenkin valmiutta työskennellä tarvittaessa myös muissa yhtiössä käytössä olevissa työaikamuodoissa tuotannon tarpeiden mukaan. Tehtävän palkka on 18,10 €/h sekä mahdolliset työehtosopimuksen mukaiset vuorolisät.MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?Vastaat tuotantolaitteiden mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta, ennakkohuolloista, korjauksista ja vikadiagnostiikasta. Työhösi kuuluu kuljettimien, voimansiirron sekä pneumaattisten ja hydraulisten järjestelmien huoltoa ja vianetsintää. Osallistut myös asennuksiin, seisokkeihin, käyttöönottoihin, kunnossapitotoimenpiteiden dokumentointiin ja toimintatapojen kehittämiseen.Liityt osaksi Toravantien kunnossapitotiimiä, jossa mekaanisen, sähkö- ja automaatiokunnossapidon osaaminen täydentävät toisiaan. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden kunnossapidon ammattilaisten ja tuotannon kanssa. Häiriötilanteita ratkaistaan yhdessä, ja tuot tiimiin erityisesti vahvaa mekaanisen kunnossapidon osaamista.MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?· soveltuvaa kone-, kunnossapito- tai muuta teknisen alan koulutusta· vahvaa käytännön kokemusta teollisuuden mekaanisesta kunnossapidosta· osaamista tuotantolaitteiden asennuksista, huolloista ja korjauksista· kokemusta vikadiagnostiikasta ja häiriötilanteiden järjestelmällisestä ratkaisemisesta· oma-aloitteista ja turvallista työotetta myös kiireellisissä tilanteissa· valmiutta dokumentoida tehdyt kunnossapitotoimenpiteet· halua oppia uusia tuotantoprosesseja ja osallistua käyttöönottoihin· yhteistyökykyä ja valmiutta jakaa osaamista muiden kunnossapidon ammattilaisten kanssaEDUKSI KATSOMME· hydrauliikan, pneumatiikan ja voimansiirtotekniikan osaamisen· kokemuksen kuljettimista, laakereista, pumpuista tai muista prosessin apulaitteista· perussähkö- ja automaatiovalmiudet sekä kokemuksen antureista, sähkömoottoreista tai sähköisesti ohjatuista laitteista· kokemuksen kunnossapitojärjestelmien käytöstä ja dokumentoinnista· kokemuksen prosessiteollisuudesta tai jatkuvatoimisesta tuotannostaMITÄ BEWI TARJOAA?Tarjoamme vakituisen työsuhteen ja mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan uuden tuotantokokonaisuuden käyttöönottoon sekä rakentamaan sen kunnossapitokäytäntöjä alusta lähtien.Saat tueksesi osaavan kunnossapitotiimin, jossa eri teknisten alueiden osaajat tukevat toisiaan. Pääset samalla kehittämään omaa osaamistasi eri tuotantolaitteiden ja -prosessien parissa. Lisäksi tarjoamme joustavat työajat, 400 euron vuosittaisen liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, kattavan työterveyshuollon, mahdollisuuden liittyä sairauskassaan sekä turvallisuuteen perustuvan kannustinjärjestelmän.KIINNOSTUITKO?Jos haluat tuoda osaamisesi uuden tuotannon käyttöönottoon ja Sastamalan kunnossapidon pitkäaikaiseen kehittämiseen, lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 15.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.LISÄTIETOJARekrytoinnista vastaa Adecco Finland. Työtehtävästä ja hakuprosessista lisätietoja antaa:Sanna Heikkilä, Senior Recruitment Consultant040 575 3208 | sanna.heikkila@adecco.fi [sanna.heikkila@adecco.fi]BEWI LYHYESTIBEWI Finland on osa BEWI-konsernia, joka toimittaa eristys-, pakkaus- ja komponenttiratkaisuja. Kehitämme ja laajennamme tuotantoamme Sastamalassa. Uudet kunnossapidon ammattilaiset tulevat osaksi BEWI:n kunnossapitoa ja voivat työskennellä tuotannon tarpeiden mukaan eri tuotantolaitteiden ja -prosessien parissa.

title: Toimistosihteeri, yhteisten sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sihteeripalvelut, Espoo
description: Haemme toimistosihteerin sijaista yhteisten sosiaali- ja terveyspalvelujen sihteeripalveluiden keskitettyjen tehtävien tiimiimme. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat hallinnolliset tehtävät ja asiakaspalvelu.Tiimimme vastaa erilaisista hallinnollisista ja taloushallinnon tehtävistä, joihin kuuluu muun muassa laskutukseen liittyvien kokonaisuuksien hallinnointi, laskureklamaatioiden käsittely sekä tietopyyntökokonaisuuden koordinointia ja hallintaa.Työ edellyttää sujuvaa tietotekniikan käyttöä, sillä tehtävissä hyödynnetään useita potilastietojärjestelmiä (esim. Lifecare, Pegasos) sekä muita hallinnon ja talouden järjestelmiä. Lisäksi työssä käytetään aktiivisesti sähköpostia ja Office 365 -ohjelmia (erityisesti Exceliä, Wordia ja PowerPointia), joiden hallinta on keskeinen osa päivittäistä työtä.Keskitettyjen tehtävien tiimi on uusi ja kehittyvä minitiimi, jonka toimintaa ja vastuita kehitetään jatkuvasti. Tiimiin ohjautuu myös uusia tehtäväkokonaisuuksia, mikä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden oppia ja vaikuttaa toiminnan kehittämiseen. Siksi etsimme henkilöä, joka on kehitysmyönteinen, oma-aloitteinen ja innostunut uuden oppimisesta.Kiinnostuitko? Odotamme hakemustasi! Hakemuksia käsitellään ja haastatteluun voidaan kutsua jo hakuajan puitteissa.Työpaikan nimi ja osoite: Yhteisten sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden sihteeripalvelut, Piispantilankuja 6a, 02240 EspooTyöaika: 36 h 15 min / viikkoTehtävä on määräaikainen sijaisuus ajalla 1.12.2026-31.1.2028 (tai sopimuksen mukaan).Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Ammattikorkeakoulu-, opisto- tai koulutasoinen tutkinto tai ammattitutkinto, esimerkiksi tradenomi tai merkonomi tai vastaava työkokemus.Tehtävässä edellytetään valmiuksia oppia uutta, järjestelmällistä ja tuloksellista työskentelyotetta sekä oma-aloitteisuutta. Lisäksi edellytämme kokemusta jonkin sosiaali- ja terveysalan asiakas- ja potilasohjausjärjestelmän käytöstä.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erinomaista suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa. Painotamme myös erityisesti ruotsin kielen taidon osaamista.Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon toimintaympäristöstä, hyvinvointialueiden palveluista, hallintomenettelyn perusteiden tuntemusta sekä sujuvia teknisiä valmiuksia uusien tietojärjestelmien ja työtapojen omaksumiseen.Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

title: Manuaalikoneistaja
description: Etsimme asiakkaallemme manuaalikoneistajaa!Työtehtäviin kuuluu mm. jyrsintä ja sorvaaminen manuaalikoneilla, sekä muut koneistajan työtehtävät huoltokeskuksella sekä asiakkaiden toimipaikoissa. Hitsaus- ja teollisuuden kunnossapitokokemus katsotaan eduksi.**Edellytämme sinulta**- koulutusta koneistusalalta tai työkokemusta koneistustehtävistä - jyrsintä- ja sorvauskokemusta manuaalikoneilta - joustavuutta ja hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja - valmiutta tehdä vastaavia työtehtäviä myös asiakkaidemme tiloissa Suomessa ja ulkomailla - piirustusten lukutaitoa - eduksi katsomme myös muun metallialan työkokemuksen, sekä Englannin ja Ruotsin kielen taidon Tarjoamme sinulle, mielenkiintoisen ja kannustavan työympäristön, jossa pääset kehittämään itseäsi kunnossapidon ammattilaiseksi.

title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: Network Engineer (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Informatik (Netzwerktechnologie)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description: Ihre Vorteile:- Internationale Projekte in einem sicherheitsrelevanten Umfeld- Moderne Netzwerktechnologien- Langfristige Perspektive in einem abwechslungsreichen ProjektumfeldIhre Aufgaben:- Planung, Konfiguration und Administration komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen- Betrieb und Optimierung von Routing- und Switching-Lösungen- Konfiguration und Management von Firewalls- Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting in produktiven Umgebungen- Unterstützung bei Infrastrukturmigrationen und Rollouts- Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams vor Ort- Erstellung technischer DokumentationenIhre Qualifikationen:- Erfahrung als Network Engineer- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Routing- und Switching-Technologien- Praxiserfahrung mit Enterprise-Firewalls- Idealerweise Zertifizierungen wie CCNA, CCNP oder vergleichbar- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse- Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft- Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü2 vorhanden oder realisierbarÜber Hays:Der Bereich IT ist unsere Kernkompetenz, auf deren Grundlage sich Hays entwickelt hat. Wir beherrschen die komplette IT-Klaviatur von Support bis zur Softwarearchitektur oder Digitalisierung – dank unseres umfangreichen Portfolios ist für jeden etwas dabei. So konnten wir in den vergangenen Jahrzehnten im Rahmen einer Life-Long-Partnerschaft unzählige Fach- und Führungskräfte aus der IT dabei unterstützen, die Weichen für eine erfolgreiche Karriere zu stellen. Unser Beratungsteam ist spezialisiert und somit in der Lage, auf Ihre Wünsche und Vorstellungen einzugehen und Sie auf Bewerbungsgespräche und Vertragsverhandlungen bestens vorzubereiten. Probieren Sie es aus und erfahren Sie, was der Markt Ihnen zu bieten hat – völlig kostenfrei, diskret und unverbindlich! Wir freuen uns auf Sie.

description: Etsimme asiakkaallemme Hyötyajoneuvoasentajaa pidempään työsuhteeseen.Yritys on erikoistunut kuljetuskaluston huoltoihin ja korjauksiin, kattaen sekä raskaan että hieman kevyemmän kaluston. Yritys toimii myös valtuutettuna huoltokorjaamona. Yrityksessä työskentelee useampi huolto- ja korjaamotoiminnan ammattilainen ja sillä on jo kymmenien vuosien kokemus vastata asiakkaiden tarpeisiin.Tehtävästä:Työskentelet hyötyajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä. Työtehtävät ovat joko huolto-ohjelman mukaisesti tehtäviä töitä tai tehtävät voivat olla äkillisiä, kuljetuskaluston vikoihin pohjautuvia korjauksia. Lisäksi valitulta henkilöltä toivotaan löytyvän osaamista myös testereiden käytöstä tai yleisesti vianhausta tai vikakoodien tulkinnasta. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää omatoimisuutta, paineensietokykyä, vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä sekä joustavaa asennetta.Tarjoamme:Mahdollisuuden työskennellä hyvässä työporukassa ja pitkät perinteet omaavassa yrityksessä. Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työn, osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen sekä ympärillesi mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön.Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Autoalan kaupan ja korjaamotoiminnan työehtosopimusta.Haku:Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Jätäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian.Täytäthän hakemuksen ensisijaisesti kotisivuillamme www.henkilostoliiga.fi [http://www.henkilostoliiga.fi]Valitettavasti emme pysty tietoturvasyistä käsittelemään sähköpostihakemuksia.Henkilöstöliiga:Henkilöstöliiga on Etelä-Suomen vahvimpia henkilöstöpalveluyrityksiä ja työllistää vuosittain yli 1000 avainpelaajaa työelämän pelikentille! Työntekijöidemme joukosta löytyy teollisuuden, logistiikan- ja kiinteistöalan osaajia, sekä toimistotyön ja palvelualan työntekijöitä. title: Business Controller, Building and technical trade division, K Group
description: Business Controller, Kesko Building and technical trade divisionWould you like to work at the heart of one of Northern Europes leading building and technical trade businesses, supporting management decisions and driving profitable growth across eight countries? Our business operates in eight countries: Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Poland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Long-term profitability target for Kesko Building and technical trade is 6-8%.We are now looking for a Business Controller to join the Building and technical trade division Business Controlling team, which is responsible for all 8 countries. Your roleAs a Business Controller, you will work closely with businesses, finance teams in different business units and other finance functions at Kesko.Your role covers division business controlling activities including monthly reporting, profitability, investments, cash flow, working capital and market analysis. An important part of your role is various analyses that leads to concrete improvement actions. You will analyse business performance and its key drivers, assess profitability from different perspectives and look behind the numbers to understand what is driving the development. Based on your analysis, you will make clear actionable recommendations and drive actions to improve performance. In addition, you will take ownership of selected development projects such as customer, product or store profitability. Your key responsibilities include: - Monthly reporting including profitability analysis, benchmarking, analysis of key performance and profitability drivers and turning analysis into improvement actions - Cash flow and working capital analysis and driving actions to improve capital efficiency  - Market analysis and insight, including market development, market shares and benchmarking  - Taking ownership of selected development projects and driving change - Supporting planning and forecasting by turning historical performance and business drivers into forward-looking analysis and scenarios  - Developing reporting and analytics including the use of automation and AI together with other organizationsTo succeed in this role, we believe that youYou are analytical, curious and business-minded. You work efficiently also under tight deadlines and pressure. You are forward-looking and able to connect data, business drivers and market insights to identify opportunities and understand cause-and-effect relationships. You have the courage to challenge, bring forward new ideas and make clear and concrete recommendations and improvement actions. You are able to influence others and drive change across the organization.You work systematically and efficiently and can take ownership of development projects, bringing together data, business understanding and the right people to achieve concrete results. We expect you to... - Have a master's degree in finance, accounting, economics, industrial engineering and management or other relevant field. - Have several years of experience in business controlling, analytics, development or project management or another analytical finance role where you have worked closely with business stakeholders. - Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Have good communication and collaboration skills. - Be proactive and have a hands-on and development-oriented way of working. - Be fluent in Finnish and English, preferably also in Swedish.Experience in market analysis, investment analysis, cash flow management and reporting development is considered an advantage.Why join us?We offer you an opportunity to work at the centre of Keskos growing, international building and technical trade business and contribute to our profitable growth.You will gain a broad perspective of different businesses, countries and markets. You will work with questions that are relevant to business performance and decision-making, ranging from profitability, cash flow and growth opportunities to market development. The role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your business controlling and analytical expertise while working closely with experienced finance and business teams. We are proud of our positive work culture and can-do attitude! At Kesko, we work in a hybrid model combining office and remote work.In addition to an impactful role, we offer: - Modern office at Kalasatama, Helsinki with excellent public transportation, as well as parking facilities. Office services include gym, healthcare services, cafeteria and restaurant - Employee benefits that include: Epassi Flex, employee discounts at K Group stores, occupational health services and leisure-time accident insurance and possibility to a car benefit according to our company policy. Our partners also offer various benefits and discounts in the areas of sports and wellbeing, travel and optical services.Interested?The application period ends on 22.11.2026. For more information about the role, please contact Anna-Kaisa Tuovinen, Head of Business Control, Kesko Building and technical trade. Best times to reach out by phone are November 6 between 13:00-14:00 and November 16 between 14:00-15:00 (+358503030183). Please submit your application with your salary request via the apply link.The selected candidate will be subject to a credit check and drug testing in accordance with Kesko's recruitment and employment practices.We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. Equality, non-discrimination and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation and career development

title: Commissioning Coordinator - Thruster Systems
description: **Commissioning Coordinator - Thruster Systems**Are you interested in working with advanced propulsion solutions for the maritime market of today and tomorrow? An exciting opportunity has arisen for a **Commissioning Coordinator** within **Global Customer Support** Thrusters at Kongsberg Maritime.In this role, you will be part of the **Customer and Delivery Operations** function within the **Thruster Systems** business area. You will have technical and delivery responsibility for commissioning of thruster systems, acting as the main interface between customers, shipyards, site teams, field service engineers, and internal stakeholders.As Commissioning Coordinator, you will have single-point responsibility for the successful commissioning and delivery of Kongsberg Maritime thruster systems. From planning and coordination to technical support and customer handover, you will work closely with customers, shipyards, Field Service Engineers and project teams to deliver high-quality results on time._This is a great opportunity for either recent graduate or professional to join our Commissioning team!_**Key Responsibilities**- Single-point responsibility for planning, executing and delivering the complete thruster commissioning scope - Develop commissioning plans and manage execution schedules - Serve as the primary contact for customers, shipyards and internal stakeholders - Support and guide Field Service Engineers during commissioning - Review installations and give technical approval of thruster system installations - Ensure technical quality, documentation and final project delivery - Identify and manage risks, deviations and improvement opportunities **What we think you should have**- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience - Experience with commissioning or technical project delivery - Strong technical understanding of complex mechanical, electrical or automation systems - Ability to plan, coordinate and drive technical activities independently - Customer-focused approach and strong communication skills - Fluent English, written and spoken - It is an advantage if you have: - Experience from the marine or offshore industry - Knowledge of thruster or propulsion systems **What We Can Offer You** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, a good benefit package, flexible working hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with our remote work, you have the opportunity to work remotely for part of your working time. By choosing Kongsberg Maritime, you will work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and high-quality solutions for the future.**Work location** Rauma, Finland | Ulsteinvik, Norway or other KM locations in EMEA**Interested?** Please submit your application including your desired salary by 23rd of November through our recruitment system**Point of contact** For more information, please contact Juha Leppänen Team Leader, Control System Engineers juha.leppanen@km.kongsberg.com or Simon Sundal Commissioning Manager simon.sundal@km.kongsberg.com**Kongsberg Maritime** is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. description: INFICON Aaland Ab söker nu noggranna och ansvarsfulla operatörer till produktionen av keramiska vakuumgivare.
