Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Grünerløkka er en sentrumsbydel med et rikt kulturliv og sosialt mangfold. 

Bydelen er den største blant Oslos bydeler etter befolkningstall, med 64.000 innbyggere. Vi har store og solide fagmiljøer og tilbyr ulike tjenester rundt de viktigste rammene av innbyggernes liv. Bydel Grünerløkka legger vekt på brukermedvirkning og samhandling med innbyggere og andre offentlige og private aktører.

Vi ønsker ansatte som er ambisiøse på egne og samfunnets vegne. Våre ledere er opptatt av å legge til rette for gode utviklingsmuligheter.

Som ansatt i Bydel Grünerløkka vil du oppleve en inkluderende kultur med stor takhøyde og mye engasjement for hverandre og de vi jobber for.

Våre ledere og ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

title: Svangerskaps vikariat 83% Nattevakts stilling
description:
Vil du være med å skape trygge netter  for mennesker som trenger det mest?

På Neskilen bofellesskap får du bruke fagkompetansen din til noe av det viktigste vi gjør: å legge til rette for gode og trygge dager .                                       

Her møter du beboere du raskt blir glad i, og et arbeidsmiljø hvor humor, respekt og samarbeid står sterkt. Hos oss er det 9 beboere, de fleste godt voksne mennesker. De har ulike behov og ønsker for livene sine. Vi gir også tjenester til brukere utenfor bofellesskapet. Vi søker nå en engasjert, trygg og  faglig nysgjerrig fagarbeider i svangerskaps vikariat på 83 % stilling,  med arbeid våken natt i ukedag og helgHos oss får du muligheten til å gjøre en reell forskjell.  Hos oss jobber vi tett sammen i et mangfoldig og tverrfaglig miljø. Vi lærer av hverandre, diskuterer løsninger sammen og deler erfaringer aktivt – fordi vi vet at gode tjenester skapes i fellesskap.Som ny hos oss blir du ivaretatt av kollegaer som både støtter, heier og hjelper deg inn i rollen, slik at du får en trygg og god start.  Ta gjerne kontakt for en utfyllende prat om stillingen. Alle søkere bes legges ved vitnemål og attester når de søker.

Politiattest må legges frem ved ansettelse. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • En jobber mye alene når en jobber våken nattevakt på Neskilen 
  • En har ansvar for de 9 beboerne på huset og bistår dem i behov de har på natt samt evt andre oppgaver . 
  • Vi jobber etter arbeidslister, nattevakts listene blir utarbeidet av nattevaktene i samråd med leder
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagarbeider 
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med kognitiv funksjonsnedsettelse samt nattarbeid 
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Norsk er vårt arbeidsspråk, og du må beherske norsk godt både muntlig og skriftlig, minimum B1- nivå
Personlige egenskaper
  • Trygg på egne faglige ferdigheter og kunne jobbe selvstendig  men også sammen med andre 
  • Er faglig engasjert og nysgjerrig
  • Har humor, fleksibilitet og et varmt hjerte
  • Er opptatt av gode relasjoner- både til beboere, pårørende og kollegaer
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt 
Vi tilbyr

Noen kan kjenne på usikkerhet når de begynner på et nytt sted. hos oss legger vi vekt på :

  • Rom for å finne din plass i eget tempo. Det er ingen som forventer at du skal kunne alt med en gang, vi står sammen om læringen
  • Kultur for å snakke sammen og dele erfaringer
  • Veiledning fra kollegaer med tverrfaglig kompetanse
  • Lønn og arbeidsbetingelser jf. kommunal tariff og retningslinjer
  • Stillingen er 83% svangerskaps vikariat  
  • Tiltredelse januar 2027
KontaktinformasjonChristina Aslaksen Solli, Vernepleier, +4791572609 ArbeidsstedNesveien 7 4810 Eydehavn Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Arendal kommune Referansenr.: 5184210467 Stillingsprosent: 83% Vikariat Søknadsfrist: 29.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du bli vår nye kollega? 

Arendal ble etablert som kjøbstad i mai 1723. Siden har det skjedd mye. I dag har Arendal kommune over 46 000 innbyggere. Kommunen er en handlekraftig organisasjon og en attraktiv arbeidsgiver for over 3500 medarbeidere. 

Vi løser viktige samfunnsoppgaver, og er en sentral aktør i utviklingen av byen og kommunen. Vi jobber aktivt med FNs bærekraftsmål, og vi er vertskommune for Arendalsuka - Norges største demokratifestival. 

Arbeidet skal preges av mangfold og våre medarbeidere skal gjenspeile Arendals befolkning. Vi ser mangfold som en styrke. Vi vil ha medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, bakgrunn, erfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. 

Arendal kommune er sertifisert som likestilt arbeidsgiver. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert; uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn, til å søke jobb hos oss. Vi jobber for heltidskultur, og ansetter fortrinnsvis i hele stillinger. Se mer om vår arbeidsgiverstrategi.

I henhold til offentlighetslovens § 25. gjør vi oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli gjort offentlig, selv om søkeren har bedt om unntak fra offentlighet.

For stillinger som arbeider med barn og unge, tjenester innen helse- og omsorg, eller brann- og eksplosjonsvern, må det foreligge tilfredsstillende politiattest før ansettelse.

title: Overlege i barne- og ungdomspsykiatri
description:
Helgelandssykehuset søker etter en barne- og ungdomspsykiater i 100% fast stilling som vil bli en del av vårt team.

Vi ønsker i utgangspunktet at du har din faste arbeidsplass ved kontoret vårt i Mosjøen. Det er viktig både for samarbeidet i teamet, arbeidsmiljøet og den faglige utviklingen vi skaper sammen i hverdagen.Samtidig vet vi at gode løsninger kan se ulike ut. For den rette kandidaten kan vi derfor legge til rette for en kombinasjon av tilstedeværelse og hjemmekontor etter nærmere avtale. Vi har god erfaring i å bruke digitale hjelpemidler som Teams og Whereby der man blant annet kan drive pasientbehandling, delta på møter og gi veiledning. Vi søker etter deg som ser mulighetene ved å arbeide på denne måten.

Som ansatt ved BUP Mosjøen får du være med på å sette preg på enheten både faglig og personlig. Du får arbeide selvstendig med høy grad av påvirkning på egen arbeidshverdag, innenfor gitte rammer. Personalet består av et godt tverrfaglig team med 11 ansatte, bestående av barne- og ungdomspsykiater, psykologspesialister, psykologer, familieterapeuter, klinisk barnevernspedagog/ sosionom/ vernepleier, spesialpedagog, spesialergoterapeut og enhetsleder. Vi har mye fokus på å ivareta det gode arbeidsmiljøet, og ser viktigheten av faglig og personlig utvikling.  

Her blir du en del av et engasjert og inkluderende fagmiljø med sterkt fokus på samarbeid og teamarbeid. BUP Mosjøen har et eget sped- og småbarnsteam som jobber spesifikt med de minste barna. Vi jobber ofte i tospann hvor vi kan spille på hverandres styrker. Vi tilbyr ulike behandlingstilnærminger som individuell behandling, foreldreveiledning, familiearbeid og gruppeterapi. 

Et godt arbeidsmiljø med trivsel, trygghet, kvalitet, givende og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i fokus, er en grunnleggende faktor for en god arbeidshverdag. Pasienteneog kvalitet i jobbutførelsen, er også et hovedfokus hos oss.

Vi tilbyr blant annet individuell terapi, familieterapi, foreldreveiledning og eksempelvis traumebehandling i form av TF-CBT og EMDR.

Klinikk for psykisk helse og rus, avdeling Mosjøen, har følgende avdelinger: BUP, døgnavdeling for barn, unge og familie (Helgelandsfunksjon), VOP m/ TSB, døgnavdeling for voksne (Helgelandsfunksjon), nevropsykologisk avdeling (Helgelandsfunksjon) samt habiliteringsavdelingen (Helgelandsfunksjon). 

På Helgeland kan du kombinere en meningsfull arbeidshverdag med et godt liv omkranset av store naturområder med fjell og fjord. Det er kort vei fra jobb til fritid. Mosjøen med den unike Sjøgata, er også en livlig kulturby med flotte tilbud innen musikk, dans, idrett og andre kulturarrangementer. Her har vi tilbud både for store og små, som skaper trivsel og gir deg mulighet for å bli kjent med byen og folket.

Her kan du lese hvordan psykiater Bouke trives i jobben.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Spesialisert psykiatrisk utredning, diagnostisering og behandling
  • Samarbeid med kommunale instanser
  • Bistå kommunene med rådgivning og veiledning
  • Være en del av den flerfaglige staben i BUP
  • Veiledning og supervisjon av LIS
  • Deltagende ved inntak og vurdering av rettighetsstatus.
  • Faglig ansvarlig for å utforme rutiner og prosedyrer i forhold til medikamentell behandling og administrering av medisiner.
  • Sitte i tverrfaglig team i forhold til diagnostikk ( akse 4), behandling, evaluering av effekt av behandling.
  • Medikamentell behandling og oppfølging
  • Skrive ut pleiepenger/ omsorgspenger til foresatte
  • Veiledning og undervisning
Tilgjengelighet:
  • Psykiater må være tilgjengelig for drøfting av akutte situasjoner, men særlig i situasjoner der medikamentell behandling er aktuell problematikk. Tilgjengelig innen en dag.
  • Diagnostiske drøftinger, inntak, og evalueringa av behandling krever ukentlige møter. Samtaler med pasienter i henhold til medisinske rutiner i avdeling. Gjennomføres ved hjelp av Teams i uker der psykiater ikke er fysisk til stede (ukentlig tilgjengelig).
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent autorisasjon som barne- og ungdomspsykiater i Norge
  • Det er ønskelig med erfaring  fra klinisk arbeid  innen psykisk helse og rus, barn og unge
  • Du må beherske skandinavisk språk  muntlig og skriftlig
  • Med fordel ha kjennskap til DIPS arena
  • Godkjent politiattest  må fremlegges ved ansettelse
  • LIS med kort tid til ferdig spesialist oppfordres til å søke
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner og evne til fleksibilitet
  • Du er tydelig faglig anliggende med evne til dialog
  • Du har godt humør og pågangsmot!
Vi tilbyr
  • Gunstige pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Lønn og ansettelsesvilkår etter avtale
  • AFUP for overleger,4 mnd i løpet av 5 år for spesialister
  • Deltagelse i Barne-og ungdomspsykiatriprogrammet i Helse Nord, regionalt fagnettverk
  • Spennende faglig fellesskap med varierte  og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et godt ,stabilt og tverrfaglig kollegialt fellesskap
  • Kompetanseutvikling
  • Mulighet for å kombinere fysisk tilstedeværelse med hjemmekontor løsning
KontaktinformasjonVibeke Pettersen, Enhetsleder, +4799232458 ArbeidsstedSkjervengan 17 8657 Mosjøen Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Helgelandssykehuset HF Referansenr.: 5202442212 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 26.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helgelandssykehuset HF er en av regionens største kompetansebedrifter, med cirka 1700 medarbeidere på Helgeland. Helgelandssykehuset tilbyr spesialisthelsetjenester innen somatisk og psykisk helse, og avhengighetsbehandling. I tillegg utdanner vi helsepersonell og investerer i din videreutdanning. Helgelandssykehuset satser betydelig på forskning og innovasjon. Våre medarbeideres kompetanse og profesjonalitet er grunnleggende for at vi skal nå visjonen om å skape Norges beste lokalsykehus, med det beste tilbudet for pasientene.  Vi setter alltid pasientene i fokus. I god samhandling med våre samarbeidspartnere og omgivelsene skal vi sikre gode og trygge helsetjenester basert på våre verdier; kvalitet, trygghet, respekt og lagspill.

Helgelandssykehuset har et særskilt ansvar for tilrettelegging av helsetilbud til den samiske befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer derfor personer med kompetanse innen sør-samisk språk og kultur til å søke.

Helgelandssykehuset HF ønsker at våre medarbeidere skal gjenspeile befolkningens mangfold og vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifiserte til å søke hos oss, uansett kjønn, alder, funksjonshemming, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn. Det samme gjelder dersom du har hatt et lengre opphold fra arbeidslivet. Vi forplikter oss til å kalle inn kvalifiserte søkere i henhold til dette, til alle utlyste stillinger.

Vi benytter oss av bakgrunnssjekk som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess.

title: Sales & Business Development Manager - Unplugged
description:
Are you ready to help us find the next market for Unplugged?

Unplugged develops and offers wireless power and data technology for demanding industrial applications to the market. As part of the Blue House group, Unplugged works closely with our sister company, Blue Logic. While Blue Logic specializes in subsea interfaces, valves, and tools, Unplugged focuses on inductive charging and gigabit data transfer, including subsea electronics and software integration.

We are looking for a self-driven commercial profile who can take our commercialized products into new markets. You will identify where our inductive products technology create value, engage with customers, build scalable sales channels and turn opportunities into orders. The role is located in Kristiansand and reports to Chief Growth Officer in Unplugged. You will also be a key member of the Blue House Commercial team.

Key Tasks
  • Identify and develop new markets, applications and customers for Unplugged’s commercialized products
  • Generate leads, engage customers and partners, and drive opportunities from first contact to order
  • Develop and execute commercial strategies with OEMs, distributors, integrators and end users
  • Develop digital sales channels and including webshop/e-commerce
  • Maintain a structured sales pipeline in CRM and provide market feedback to drive product and commercial strategies
  • Marketing strategies
Qualifications
  • Commercial and self-driven, with experience from B2B sales, technical sales, business development, or e-commerce. 3-5 years experience
  • Self-driven and comfortable in engaging in customer dialog translating technology into clear customer value
  • Experience with webshop, digital sales channels or scalable product sales with partners is a strong advantage
  • Experience in subsea/marine and/or military industry is an advantage
  • Technical education or experience in engineering, electronics, automation or similar is beneficial
  • Professional English is required; Norwegian and other languages are an advantage
Why Join Unplugged?

You will join a small, ambitious technology company where ideas can quickly become actions. The role offers real freedom to explore new markets, build new sales channels and directly influence how Unplugged continues its grow journey.

ContactsLars Inge Holte, General Manager, Activepeople AS, +47 91 89 43 06, lih@activepeople.no LocationSagmyra 23 4624 KRISTIANSAND S Key information:Employer: Unplugged AS Reference number: 5204778157 Percentage of full-time: 100% Regular Application deadline: 18/11/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 

About Unplugged Unplugged™ is a pioneer in wireless power systems, delivering modules from 30 W to 25 kW with up to 95% efficiency. Our technology powers the world’s longest-resident subsea drones and is currently being integrated into NATO DIANA programs and the next generation of subsea robotics.

Join us in unplugging the future of subsea operations! https://www.unplugged.no

title: Project Controller
description:
Kongsberg Maritime is looking for a Project Controller to join our Energy & Control, Finance team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring strong financial control and support throughout the lifecycle of our projects.As Project Controller, you will work closely with Project Managers and colleagues across Finance, Sales, Delivery and Product management. You will contribute to delivering high-quality financial insights, maintaining project profitability, and supporting successful project execution.

  What you will be doing  • Be an active, supporting and challenging member of the Project team. • Establish projects in ERP systems and maintain project budgets and forecasts • Perform invoicing and crediting activities  • Support month-end closing activities, including revenue and cost recognition  • Prepare monthly project reporting and participate in project reviews  • Identify and evaluate financial risks and opportunities  • Provide financial support and analysis to project teams and stakeholders  • Contribute to continuous improvement and other ad hoc tasks within the Finance team

We're looking for someone who's service-minded, flexible, and eager for new challenges. If, you are someone who loves being given responsibility and can communicate clearly, we would like to hear from you!

We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!

  We think you should have  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field. – Master’s degree is a bonus.

• Strong experience from a similar finance or project controlling role. • Understanding of commercial and contractual aspects of project business  • Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems, expected MS Office and Power BI knowledge - an interest in exploring AI is an advantage. • Good written and verbal communication skills in English

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

  You are able to  • Act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results

• Have an analytically focused mind and well-versed business understanding. • Focus on bottom-line results, identify potential risks and monitor the financial impact of own activities.  • Comply with company rules and procedures and execute plans with commitment and determination.  • Use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate resources effectively.  • Communicate in a clear, precise and structured way.  • Co-operate well with others, share knowledge, experience, information and support others in the pursuit of team goals. 

If you're ready to take on this exciting challenge, apply now and become a part of our team! 

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

  What we can offer you  With us, you will be offered a competitive salary and benefits package, along with development opportunities in an international environment. We offer flexible working hours, good pension & insurance schemes, and an inclusive supportive work environment. You will have the opportunity to work with sustainable and forward-looking solutions in the maritime industry.

 

Work location  Kongsberg, Sandefjord.   Point of contact  Petter Antunez, Finance Manager.+47 976 92 486petter.antunez@km.kongsberg.com 

  Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Energy & Control brings together Kongsberg Maritime’s strengths in Vessel Automation & Sensing Solutions, Offshore Production, Ship Design & Integration, Bridge & Remote and Electrical Systems to deliver smart, integrated solutions across the ocean space. From single products to fully integrated systems, we help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability, enabling the maritime energy transition. Our global teams operate end-to-end, from sales through product development and engineering to project execution - making us a trusted partner for yards, ship owners and operators across segments.

title: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
description: On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.About the positionAs a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.Your responsibilities will include:    Providing nursing care and following up patients    Clinical observation, assessment and documentation    Medication management and treatment    Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes    Making independent clinical assessments    Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare serviceWho are we looking for?We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.You:    Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country    Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country    Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work    Hold a valid driving licence    Work well both independently and as part of a team    Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care servicesWe help you prepare for working in NorwayYou do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.We provide:    Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher    Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals    Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation    Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work    Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway    Personal follow-up before, during and after your moveThe language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.What you can expect in Jondal    A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system    Varied work across nursing home and home care services    The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills    Independent professional responsibility    Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals    The opportunity to follow patients over time    Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangementsLife between the fjord, mountains and glacierJondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

title: PhD Candidate in Machine Learning Approaches to Conservation Condition Needs of Historic Buildings
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

For a position as a PhD Candidate, the goal is a completed doctoral education up to an obtained doctoral degree.

We are looking for a PhD candidate for one of 13 PhD positions in Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) CHARM (Conservation of Heritage Architecture, buildings and sites by Resilient Methods: hydro-climate factors) project. The main objective of CHARM MSCA Doctoral Network project is to develop new sustainable conservation and restoration solutions, adapted to the current and future climate conditions, designed in a circular economy philosophy, having a low environmental footprint and high handprint. CHARM also responds to socio-economical requirements of wellbeing and proposes conservation/restoration solutions economically acceptable and respecting the cultural value of buildings.

CHARM proposes a holistic approach including:

  • Site observation and data collection
  • Data preparation to be used by AI, models, etc
  • Methods for understanding and modelling past and future degradation of architectural heritage
  • Sustainable conservation solutions to several observed problems
  • Assessment of the impact of architectural conservation on the environment and of the environment (past, present and future) on architectural heritage
  • Bidirectional interactions with society proposing risk management plans but also taking into account the society wills and needs

The vision of CHARM MSCA project is to educate young and talented scientists towards a combined high-level experimental and data driven approach for the early-stage accurate, precise detection of hydro-climate impact on cultural heritage, to answer to recruitment needs in time of climate change and natural hazards impact about research and innovation in the sector of cultural heritage conservation and restoration. 

CHARM network gathers excellent academic centers that have decennial experience in the field of risk assessment, adaptation and mitigation solutions to the climate change impact, conservation of cultural heritage and restoration, documented by scientific papers published in high impact-factor journals, and by previous EU funded research projects. CHARM puts together researchers from universities and research organisms, national and local organizations in charge of Cultural Heritage conservation, Small and Midsize Enterprises, industrial producer of building materials, and Non-Governmental Organization, from 9 European and 1 South American countries.

Description of DC2 PhD position

Project title: Understanding conservation condition and rehabilitation needs at district scale in time of energy saving and climate change via machine learning driven method

Topic in brief:

The aim is to implement an approach based on artificial intelligence (AI) in the form of CNN to automatically detect cracks and morphological indices in order to manage the large amount of data obtained from photogrammetry and earth observations images.

Objectives:

This doctoral project aims to develop deep learning neural networks to investigate data in available database (e.g., EU building stock observatory and other similar database) to:

  1. classify building stock at district scale more prone to decay based on buildings construction year, location, main constitutive material, exposure, use and
  2. to predict potential maintenance and restoration priority based on (i) and existing energy retrofit directive and/or risk maps 

Expected results:

(i)to build high-quality dataset highlighting the façade that is more prone to decay at district/city level from existing raw database; 

(ii) to apply deep learning neural networks (e.g., convolutional neural network) to perform semi-automatic decay pattern segmentation and associated mapping; 

(iii) to correlate the maintenance of buildings at district/city level with decay patterns/features at district scale to prioritize large scale intervention; and 

(iv) to optimize the maintenance activities by leveraging these correlations learned by machine-learning based approaches. 

Supervisory Committee:

  • Main supervisor: Full prof. Chiara Bertolin, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Co-supervisor: Associate prof. Chao Gao, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Mentor: Dr. Marie Louise Anker, Department Director at Nidaros Cathedral Restoration Works. (Non.Academic)

 

Planned secondments

SECONDMENT 1 - Prof. P. Fafalios (FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas, Crete) M12, duration: 4 weeks, AI and ML algorithms,

SECONDMENT 2 - Prof. Carradò (CY Cergy Paris University) Karima El Ganaoui, ESTI Pau CY Tech, M24, duration: 4 weeks, AI materials

Duties of the position
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop a quantitative deep-learning-based framework to detect the micro-cracks and validate the developed framework
  • Define micro-scale indices to evaluate crack morphological characteristics and validate developed the indices
  • Classify the micro-morphologies and damages of undamage and damage materials and/or hazard prone or not buildings and landscape
  • Participate in other relevant research and dissemination activities through our international collaborators
  • Conduct and publish high-level research at peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Carry on condition monitoring campaigns and surveys in situ
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • Excellent written and oral English
  • Strong background in applying deep learning neural networks on image segmentation associated with materials and the built environment
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and Matlab

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience in processing-imaging techniques (e.g. 3D Data Processing, point clouds, geospatial Analysis)
  • Knowledge and technical skills of condition monitoring, analytical damage functions and/or analytical methods/models
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Strong interest and self-motivated attitude to explore scientific questions
  • Think and work independently
  • Team player with cooperative attitude
  • Good communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Opportunity to carry our cutting-edge research in the area of applying machine learning technique to detection, classification and prediction of material degradation and get multidisciplinary and multisectoral training by experts and experienced supervisors from academic world
  • Opportunity to publish your research findings in working team and participate the national and international conferences
  • Opportunity to stay at our academic partners at FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas in Crete (Greece), and Cergy Paris University in Paris, France.
  • Opportunity to work in an international team and be part of a network of 13 PhD students
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding from Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) for CHARM project.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Motivation letter justifying your interest and fit for the position
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Chiara Bertolin, e-mail: chiara.bertolin@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

title: Are you passionate about crisis management, emergency preparedness and building organizational resilience in a global organization?
description:
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Global Security Manager – Crisis Management to strengthen our global security and resilience capability.

In this role, your main responsibility will be crisis management and business continuity, you will work close with our team, and also be involved in a variety of security areas such as personnel security, physical security, information security and travel security. 

You will have a key responsibility for further developing our global approach to crisis management and emergency preparedness. You will work closely with management, security professionals, business units and functions across the organization to ensure that we are prepared to respond effectively when serious incidents occur.The position combines strategic development, governance and hands-on operational crisis management, and requires someone who is comfortable working both proactively and in situations where time, information and predictability may be limited.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve the company’s global Crisis Management framework, including governance, processes, plans and supporting tools.
  • Support and further develop the organization’s Emergency Response and Crisis Management structure globally.
  • Support the establishment and development of local and regional emergency response capabilities, crisis management exercises and training for management teams and relevant functions.
  • Contribute to the broader development of Business Continuity Management and organizational resilience.
  • Together with the Security team you will monitor relevant global developments and emerging risks that may affect our people and operations.
  • Participate in operational crisis response when required, as a important coordinating role in the global crisis management team.
  • Collaborate with the Travel Security Board team. 
We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for! 

What we are looking for:

We believe you have solid experience within crisis management, emergency preparedness, security, resilience or related disciplines, combined with the ability to translate frameworks and requirements into practical solutions.Relevant experience may come from international industry, corporate security, emergency preparedness, defence, police, public authorities or consulting.We are particularly interested in candidates who have:

  • Experience with crisis management and emergency response in a complex organization.
  • Experience developing crisis management plans, frameworks and response structures.
  • Experience planning and facilitating exercises, training and scenario-based crisis management activities.
  • Experience supporting management during serious incidents or crises.
  • Strong understanding of crisis leadership, decision-making and coordination under pressure.
  • Ability to work across organizational, geographical and cultural boundaries.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international organization with global operations will be considered an advantage.Knowledge of recognized standards and good practices within crisis management and business continuity, including ISO 22301 and ISO 27001, will also be beneficial. 

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.This employment requires security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority. The successful candidate may start work with limited accesses whilst the clearance is being processed. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment. Personal qualitiesTo succeed in this role, you are structured and analytical, while also being pragmatic and operational when the situation requires it.You:
  • remain calm and focused in demanding situations;
  • are comfortable making progress when information is incomplete;
  • communicate clearly with both management and operational teams;
  • build trust and strong professional relationships;
  • take initiative and drive improvement;
  • are curious and continuously look for ways to strengthen preparedness;
  • understand that effective crisis management is ultimately about people, leadership, preparation and the ability to act.

You should also be comfortable working in an international environment and travelling when required.

Why join us?

Serious incidents rarely follow the plan. - Good crisis management therefore depends not only on having procedures in place, but on having an organization that is prepared, trained and capable of making good decisions when it matters most.As Global Security Manager – Crisis Management, you will have the opportunity to influence how a global organization prepares for and responds to critical events, working across countries, functions and management levels.You will be part of a professional security environment where preparedness, learning and continuous improvement are important elements in protecting our people, operations and business. 

 Work location:Any of Kongsberg Maritimes locations in Norway, though Kongsberg, Horten or Lysaker is preferred.We are flexible on working arrangements. Point of contact:Hanne Marit SchultzDirector Security & Crisis ManagementTel: +47 913 42 479 Link til søknadsskjema: Send application

title: PhD Candidate - Hydrogen and Industrial Decarbonization Pathways
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

We invite applications for a 3-year PhD Candidate position on the future role of hydrogen and hydrogen products in industrial decarbonization. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management (IØT) is to carry out education, research, and innovation activities at an international level at the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE. The department’s activities aim to contribute to sustainable value creation within technology-based areas in industry, business, and the public sector in Norway

 

About the position

Electrification is widely promoted as a key pathway to industrial decarbonization. At the same time, hydrogen and carbon capture and storage (CCS) are increasingly recognized as important solutions for sectors where direct electrification may be difficult or uneconomic. This has led to a growing debate about the future role of "electrons versus molecules" in a net-zero economy.

Most existing studies assume that today's industrial structure remains largely unchanged and focus on how current industries can reduce emissions. However, deep decarbonization may fundamentally reshape industrial production, value chains, competitiveness, and the location of energy-intensive activities. As a result, future hydrogen demand may depend as much on industrial transformation as on technological choices.

This PhD project will investigate how alternative pathways toward a zero-emission industrial sector affect the future demand for hydrogen and the development of hydrogen value chains. The research will analyze the interplay between electrification, hydrogen, and CCS, while explicitly accounting for potential changes in industrial structures and production systems.

 

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How will future hydrogen demand vary across alternative industrial decarbonization pathways?
  • Which industrial sectors are likely to rely on electrification, hydrogen, or CCS to achieve net-zero emissions?
  • How might industrial transformation affect hydrogen production, transport, storage, and trade?
  • What level of hydrogen deployment is required to justify dedicated hydrogen infrastructure and markets?
  • How can Europe and Norway prepare for different industrial and energy-system transition pathways?

 

The successful candidate will develop and analyze future scenarios for industrial transformation, hydrogen demand, and infrastructure development. The project will contribute to the scientific and policy debate on how competitive zero-emission industries can emerge under different transition strategies.

Research environment

The PhD candidate will join a multidisciplinary research environment at the intersection of energy economics, industrial economics, operations research, and energy systems analysis.

The position is affiliated with FME HYDROGENi, the Norwegian Research and Innovation Centre for Hydrogen and Ammonia. The centre brings together 46 research and industry partners to develop the knowledge, technologies, and solutions needed to support a sustainable hydrogen economy and contribute to Norway's ambitions for climate neutrality and industrial transformation. FME HYDROGENi conducts research across the hydrogen value chain, including hydrogen production, transport and storage, industrial and maritime applications, safety, and the broader role of hydrogen in future energy systems. The centre is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Centres for Environment-friendly Energy Research (FME) programme and operates during the period 2022-2030

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project

The PhD candidate will:

  • Conduct original scientific research on hydrogen and industrial decarbonization pathways.
  • Develop and analyze scenarios for industrial transformation and climate neutrality.
  • Assess the future role of electrification, hydrogen, and CCS across industrial sectors.
  • Quantify hydrogen demand and infrastructure requirements under alternative transition pathways.
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences.
  • Collaborate with academic, industry, and public-sector partners.
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme.
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research findings.

 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU’s grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:

  • Operations research or optimization
  • Energy systems
  • Energy Economics
  • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Or other closely related disciplines.

Applicants must demonstrate strong analytical and quantitative skills.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with energy system modelling, scenario analysis, or techno-economic analysis.
  • Knowledge of hydrogen technologies, industrial decarbonization, or climate policy.
  • Experience with quantitative modelling and data analysis.
  • Programming skills in Python, Julia, R, GAMS, or similar tools.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary research at the interface of technology, economics, and policy.

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in an interdisciplinary research environment. 
  • Is interested in research with relevance for industry, policy, and society.

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Close collaboration with leading researchers in energy systems modelling, optimization, and something else 
  • Opportunities to engage with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in research addressing key challenges of the green transition.
  • Opportunities for international research stays and conference participation.
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU 

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

 

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of at least two potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. Description of the documentation required can be found here. Please note that diploma Supplement is required to attach for European Master Diplomas outside Norway. Chinese applicants are required to provide confirmation of Master Diploma from China Credentials Verification (CHSI).  

If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.  

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal and interpersonal qualities. Motivation, ambitions, and potential for research will also count in the assessment of the candidates.  

NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public applicant list with names, ages, job titles, and municipalities of residence will be prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to reserve yourself from being included on the public applicant list, this must be justified. The assessment will be made in accordance with applicable laws. You will be notified if the reservation is not accepted.

Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is Norway's technology capital with a population of over 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens, and general equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized childcare is readily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers excellent educational opportunities (including international schools) and opportunities to enjoy nature, culture, and family life, with low crime rates and clean air quality.

Questions about the position can be directed to Professor Asgeir Tomasgard (asgeir.tomasgard @ntnu.no) or Professor Anne Neumann (anne.neumann@ntnu.no).

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Oddny Lyngvær at oddny.lyngvar@ntnu.no.

 

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

Application deadline: 11.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management

We conduct research and teaching at an international level in the interface between technology/natural sciences and economics, management, and HSE (health, safety and the environment). Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is one of four departments in the Faculty of Economics and Management.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Special Needs Education
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.

More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.

We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 – NOK 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • Attractive welfare benefits
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter of maximum one page (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A three-page project description including background/theoretical relevance, research aims, and planned methodological and analytical approaches, in addition to a one-page progress plan. The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Up to three peer-reviewed academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment.

Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

title: IT lead
description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As IT Lead, you will establish and run Nordscale Operations’ internal IT function in Narvik. As our first internal IT appointment, you will initially focus on hands-on operations and employee support, working closely with our external IT provider. You will also collaborate across functions within the organisation, beyond day-to-day user support.

 

The scope covers internal corporate IT and access to partner systems. As the organisation grows, your responsibility will expand towards IT strategy.

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

  • Run day-to-day IT operations: configure PCs and software, support users, and manage onboarding, accounts, access, and single sign-on across internal and partner systems.
  • Establish IT policies and procedures for cybersecurity, data protection, and business continuity; implement Nscale’s configuration and security requirements with site leadership and external specialists.
  • Manage equipment and software procurement, licences, asset lifecycles, and relationships with IT vendors and service providers.
  • Deliver upgrades, migrations, and technical refreshes; monitor performance, uptime, and user experience; and develop compatible, scalable infrastructure and support services.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may be an experienced IT consultant, systems administrator, or operational IT professional ready to build a function. Experience in or supporting larger organisations with several partners is valuable; previous senior IT leadership experience is not required.

 

You enjoy practical work, connect technical decisions with longer-term business needs, and keep up to date with technology trends.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Self-driven and structured, taking ownership of decisions, priorities, and outcomes.
  • A service-oriented problem-solver who identifies risks and preventive measures.
  • Collaborative across teams and partners, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical colleagues.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid hands-on experience across networks, infrastructure, cloud services, software administration, user support, and account and access management.
  • Good working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance, including implementing policies and procedures.
  • Experience with IT assets, procurement, licences, and vendors, plus upgrades, migrations, and scalable service improvements.
  • Fluent Norwegian and English, written and spoken. Relevant IT management, systems administration, or cybersecurity certification is desirable, not required.

 

What We Can Offer You

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
  • The opportunity to build an internal IT function, combining practical technical work with a path towards broader strategic responsibility.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
