title: Global R&D Manager Verification and Validation
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:This is a senior and independent leadership position with responsibility for establishing global verification and validation practices across Surface Mining Automation. You will have a unique opportunity to influence technology decisions, quality standards, and release readiness across a portfolio of strategic automation programs. At Epiroc, we're accelerating the transformation of mining through automation and digitalization. As our Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will play a key role in ensuring that our solutions are safe, predictable, compliant, and ready to deliver value for our customers around the world. Join our team You will be part of Surface Mining R&D Automation, a globally connected organization developing autonomous and software-defined mining solutions. Together with colleagues across R&D, Systems Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Release Management, we create innovative technologies that improve safety, productivity, and sustainability in mining operations. Your mission As Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will establish and lead a global approach to verification and validation, helping ensure the successful delivery of automation solutions across regions and programs. Your responsibilities will include: Defining and continuously improving a global verification and validation strategy aligned with the V-model.     Leading system- and machine-level verification activities across integrated automation solutions.     Establishing clear release-readiness criteria, quality gates, and data-driven decision frameworks.     Ensuring traceability from requirements to verification results, supported by robust documentation and compliance processes.     Collaborating with engineering teams to identify risks early and improve solution quality from the start.     Enabling scalable verification through reusable test methods, assets, and environments including HiL, SIL, and virtual testing.     Supporting FAT/SAT activities and customer acceptance processes.     Developing global V&V capabilities, common ways of working, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous improvement. Profile description:Your Profile We are looking for a collaborative and experienced leader who combines systems thinking with a passion for quality and continuous improvement. You build trust through expertise, communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, and enjoy creating alignment across global teams. You are equally comfortable engaging with senior leaders on strategic priorities as working closely with engineers and technical specialists to drive execution and solve complex challenges. You have a leadership style that inspires confidence, builds engagement, and helps teams successfully navigate change in complex global organizations. With a strong quality mindset and a structured approach, you know how to establish new ways of working, gain stakeholder commitment, and drive sustainable improvements across teams and functions. You are comfortable making informed decisions based on data and evidence while supporting others in finding solutions to complex challenges. To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:     Experience in system-level verification and validation within automation, embedded systems, control systems, software-intensive products, or system integration.     Strong leadership experience in global or cross-functional environments, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders.     Strong experience leading change management initiatives, including organizational, process, or technology transformations and driving adoption across global teams.The ability to communicate effectively at both strategic and operational levels, translating complex technical topics into clear business insights while building strong relationships with engineering teams.     A strong focus on quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.     Knowledge of verification strategies, requirements traceability, system integration, release processes, and verification environments such as HiL, SIL, or simulation-based testing.     Experience with customer acceptance activities, field-deployed automation, compliance, or functional safety is considered an advantage.     A degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Advanced studies and leadership development experience are welcome.     Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.     Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage. Location and travel This position is based in Örebro, Sweden. For the right candidate, a flexible location within one of Epiroc's sites may be considered. International travel of up to 40% is expected. Application and contactsPlease send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 19th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Lead BESS Electrical Design Engineer
description: Company description:.Job description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.    We shape the world we want to live in!    Volvo Energy is a young company in the Volvo Group which supports customers in the electrical energy transition. Volvo Energy develops and commercializes competitive Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and provides customers with reliable solutions which optimize energy costs, operational resilience, and renewable energy integration. We are now looking for a new colleague to join our team at Volvo Energy as Lead BESS Electrical Design Engineer.     What are we looking for in this specific role?   In this role, we are looking for an experienced electrical design engineer passionate about electrification and energy transition. You will play a key role in developing electrical design solutions for BESS turnkey projects and bringing our future products and offers to market. You are a structured and solution-oriented team player who works effectively with customers, grid owners, suppliers, consultants, contractors, and cross-functional project teams to deliver safe, compliant, and buildable solutions. Responsibilities include:•    Produce and maintain the complete BESS site design package in AutoCAD, including single-line diagrams, site layouts, cable sizing and routing, cable schedules, and equipment lists.•    Define the protection philosophy and settings and coordinate protection interfaces across the BESS, site, and grid connection.•    Design earthing and lightning protection systems.•    Define the metering strategy, including metering points, equipment, and grid owner and revenue-metering requirements.•    Support in the plant control and communication strategy covering interfaces between PCS, EMS/PPC, SCADA, grid operator, and aggregator.•    Define the civil works requirements and subcontractor scope.•    Prepare the technical content of procurement packages and review supplier documentation and designs for compliance.•    Act as BAS-P for projects where assigned.•    Support site activities and commissioning when required and approve or produce the final as-built documentation.•    Develop reusable design standards and validated solutions to improve quality and efficiency across future projects.     Who are you?   Expected qualifications: •    Degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience.•    Experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).•    Experience in electrical design for power, energy, industrial, or utility-scale projects.•    Experience with protection systems, grid connection, controls, metering, and electrical safety.•    Experience producing electrical design documentation in AutoCAD or similar.•    Understanding of HV, MV, and LV systems, earthing, lightning protection, and applicable compliance requirements.•    Self-motivated, structured, and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, suppliers, contractors, consultants, and internal teams. Meriting:•    Experience acting as BAS-P.     Ready for the next move?   Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!   Feel free to contact me if you have further questions     Mohmmed Koufahi, Head of Solutions Engineering, mohmmed.koufahi@volvo.com Application deadline: 25 November 2026   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.     We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Energy lives and leads the change in accelerating Volvo Group’s electrification journey and driving circularity for a better tomorrow. We bring together people with who will work in a highly diverse, equal and inclusive global context with an entrepreneurial spirit where everyone is key and directly contributes to achieving our ambitions for wanted position: better for people – better for planet – better for business. Together – from individual success to collective significance!

title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming BESS
description: Company description:"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."Job description:Background    The increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability.      Research Question   The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems. Objectives     Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication.      Improve dynamic response during power dispatch.      Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing.      Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations.      Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by   voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs.       Scope Of Work       Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4]      Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12]      Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21]      Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26]      Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29]       Candidate Competencies       Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems      Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable.      Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit.       Ready for the next move?   Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today! You will be informed if applicable.

EnglishWe would like you to have a background in mechanical maintenance, preferably in heavy industry, as well as an upper-secondary school diploma or equivalent qualification.The following experience would be an advantage:    Working in a rolling mill workshop or a mould and segment workshop    Bearing maintenance and/or tribology    Quality inspections and the use of related measuring equipmentWe value personal qualities such as attention to detail, problem-solving skills and a strong sense of responsibility. You should be able to work both independently and as part of a team, and be flexible and adaptable to changes in the work environment. You should be comfortable communicating in Swedish and/or English and understand the importance of following safety procedures to maintain a safe and secure workplace.You take initiative and actively contribute to improving and streamlining our ways of working and processes.Om SMS group/Abour SMS groupSvenskaVi använder vår 150-åriga erfarenhet och digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt förse industrin med innovativa produkter och processer. Tillsammans bygger vi upp ett starkt team och vi erbjuder stora utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter för dig som har ambition och vilja.EnglishWe draw on 150 years of experience and digital expertise to continuously provide industry with innovative products and processes. Our goal is to pave the way for a carbon-neutral and sustainable metals industry.SMS group is a leading partner for challenging industrial projects, supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their plants. Together, we are building a strong team and offer excellent opportunities for development and career progression to those with the ambition and drive to succeed.Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?SvenskaLåter det här som en intressant möjlighet? If so, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. If you have any questions about the position, please do not hesitate to contact us.Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Partnership Coordinator to Airmee
description: Who we are We've completed over 40 million deliveries, serving millions of consumers and some of the largest e-commerce retailers in the Nordics. As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue.And we're just getting started. With a proven platform, growing market share and significant opportunities ahead, we're entering our next phase of growth.We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it. About the roleThis is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in logistics and operations while taking on increasing responsibility in a fast-growing company.As a Partner Coordinator at Airmee, you’ll play a role in ensuring our delivery network runs smoothly and efficiently. You will be the go-to contact for selected last mile and linehaul carriers, making sure they receive the support, information, and coordination needed to deliver great service. You’ll be a part of our Carrier Management team and work closely with other Partner coordinators and the Partnership Manager to support both daily operations and planning activities.Key responsibilities:    Act as the point of contact for a selection of our last mile and linehaul carriers, ensuring they receive timely support and information    Monitor daily performance and service quality using dashboards and KPIs, and share insights with both carriers and internal teams    Collaborate with Dispatch and other teams to quickly resolve issues related to delays, damages, or customer complaints    Assist in capacity planning by aligning vehicle supply with both short-term fluctuations and long-term forecasts    Ensure scheduling and shift templates are accurate and up to date, and help fill gaps through close coordination with carrier partners    Support the onboarding of new carriers and ensure compliance with Airmee’s standards, Code of Conduct, and operational routinesWho are we looking for?    We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, operational environment and enjoys working collaboratively to solve problems and keep things running smoothly.    You’re detail-oriented and structured, but flexible enough to adapt when plans change.    You have a natural sense of ownership and take initiative to improve day-to-day operations.    With communication skills, you build trust with both internal teams and external partners.    Being data-minded, you use insights to guide decisions and drive performance forward.Requirements:    Experience in logistics, customer support, operations or similar.    Fluency in Swedish or English.    Good Excel skillsAre You Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?Submit your application today!

title: Lead Power System & Grid Compliance
description: Company description:.Job description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.    We shape the world we want to live in!    Volvo Energy is a young company in the Volvo Group which supports customers in the electrical energy transition. Volvo Energy develops and commercializes competitive Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and provides customers with reliable solutions which optimize energy costs, operational resilience, and renewable energy integration. We are now looking for a new colleague to join our team at Volvo Energy as Lead Power System and Grid Compliance.      What you will do   In this role, we are looking for a power system engineer who can lead the grid connection and compliance process for BESS projects. You combine strong power system knowledge with hands-on experience in PowerFactory and can translate grid code and grid owner requirements into technical studies, testing activities, and approval documentation. You are structured, analytical, and comfortable taking technical ownership. You are a team player who works effectively with DSOs, TSOs, customers, suppliers, aggregators, consultants, and internal project and product teams. Responsibilities:     Lead the RfG and grid connection process for BESS projects, from requirement clarification through ION, EON, FON, compliance testing, and final approval.     Act as the primary technical interface towards DSOs, TSOs, and other grid stakeholders throughout the grid connection process.     Perform and coordinate PowerFactory, EMT, harmonic, protection, and other power system studies required to demonstrate compliance with grid code and connection requirements.     Prepare simulation reports, compliance documentation, and technical submissions required for grid owner approvals and operational notifications.     Coordinate compliance testing, witness testing, and verification activities with grid owners, suppliers, and project teams.     Support supplier selection, design reviews, and technical requirements to ensure BESS systems meet applicable grid code and connection requirements.     Lead aggregator sourcing, technical integration, and prequalification activities where required.      Who are you?   Expected qualifications:•    Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience.•    Experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).•    Experience with power system studies, simulations, and grid connection activities using PowerFactory or similar tools.•    Experience with grid code compliance and utility-scale energy projects, such as BESS, solar, wind, or substations.•    Understanding power system behavior, including protection systems, harmonics, and dynamic performance, with experience preparing technical studies, simulation reports, and compliance documentation.•    Self-motivated, structured, and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with customers, grid owners, suppliers, and internal teams.•    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.     Ready for the next move?   Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!   Feel free to contact me if you have further questions     Mohmmed Koufahi, Head of Solutions Engineering, mohmmed.koufahi@volvo.com Application deadline: 25 November 2026   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.     We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Volvo Energy lives and leads the change in accelerating Volvo Group’s electrification journey and driving circularity for a better tomorrow. We bring together people with who will work in a highly diverse, equal and inclusive global context with an entrepreneurial spirit where everyone is key and directly contributes to achieving our ambitions for wanted position: better for people – better for planet – better for business. Together – from individual success to collective significance!

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description: DevSecOps ConsultantWho are we?Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.Job descriptionJoin Amaris Consulting as a DevSecOps Consultant in Gothenburg and contribute to a strategic project for one of our clients in the automotive sector. Within a Cyber Security Expert Team, the role focuses on supporting development and platform teams with security expertise, governance, and practical DevSecOps practices across cloud, application, and platform environments.Your missions    Provide operational security support to development and platform teams on security questions, findings, incidents, and risk assessments.    Support the integration of automated security controls, scanning, and policies into development lifecycles and CI/CD pipelines.    Contribute to secure design and implementation across cloud environments, applications, and container-based platforms.    Assist teams with vulnerability handling, third-party dependency management, and software supply chain security practices.    Coach development and platform teams on practical security measures that support delivery speed and reliability.    Apply established security best practices, benchmarks, and governance standards across technical environments.    Share knowledge within the Cyber Security Expert Team to improve ways of working and common practices.    Contribute to the development of security standards, guidelines, and reusable approaches across the organization.Your profile    Experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or security engineering within development or platform environments.    Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms and core services, including compute, identity, networking, logging, and monitoring.    Experience with vulnerability management, secure development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and security automation.    Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.    Knowledge of container orchestration platforms, code scanning, artifact scanning, and dependency governance is a plus.    Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks is a plus.    Academic background in cybersecurity, computer science, software development, information systems, or a related field is appreciated.    English fluent. Swedish is a plus.    Strong analytical and structured mindset, with the ability to work independently in complex technical environments.    Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: IT Support, part-time to a company within circular grocery
description: Seeking a flexible and impactful part-time IT role? We are looking for a junior IT Support Specialist to join a forward-thinking circular grocery company in Stockholm. In this role, you will balance first-line helpdesk support with daily IT security tasks—making it an ideal fit alongside your studies or other commitments. Apply today - selection is ongoing.About the roleIn this role, you will manage daily IT operations and security tasks for our customer. You will support employees with their technical needs, manage cloud platforms, and ensure the organization's technical setup remains secure and aligned with industry standards.You are offeredThis is a flexible, part-time position (50% / 20 hours per week) perfect for students or junior professionals looking to gain hands-on IT experience. It offers a highly adaptable schedule (mornings or afternoons) and a supportive environment to learn and grow.Work tasksA dual-focus role handling first-line helpdesk support and essential IT security tasks to keep daily office operations running securely and smoothly.    Provide on-site and remote IT support to employees for accounts and hardware.      Administer and support devices using Microsoft Intune.      Manage users, groups, and access in Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace.      Perform basic network troubleshooting on office infrastructure, including Wi-Fi and printers.      Support security operations, including patch management and triaging Microsoft Defender alerts.      Manage and troubleshoot integrations such as single sign-on (SSO).      Assist the Legal team with GDPR requests and manage password systems like 1Password.We are looking for    Higher education in IT or a related field of study.    You have another primary occupation of at least 50% (e.g., studies).    Basic knowledge of IT support and network troubleshooting.    Basic knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and/or Google Workspace.    Professional proficiency in English.It is meritorious if you have    Previous experince working with IT-support    Basic knowledge of Jira and GDPR processes.    Proficiency in Swedish.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:    Supportive    Social    Orderly    Responsible    Intellectually curiousOur recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process. To join us in a part-time role, you’ll need another main activity that covers at least 50% of your time. That could be studies, another job, running your own business, parental leave, or something similar.

title: Auditor with experience MID
description: Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. We see that experience and knowledge are invaluable assets, so it's crucial to us that you contribute with your expertise to promote PwC's development. Together, we create a meaningful and rewarding career for you.Become part of PwC's audit operationsAs an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. You get to work in inspiring and meaningful assignments where our work affects our customers' business operations, but also contributes to creating trust in society.The digital development and increased demands for transparency contribute to the fact that the audit of the future will require more multifaceted competence than before, which also provides more opportunities for specialization. At PwC, working as an auditor can look very different and this means that you can create your own career path. You can choose to become a customer manager or immerse yourself in a specialist area such as data analysis, sustainability reporting, internal control or invest in a career as a leader.Read more about our service areas within auditingWho are you?We are looking for you who have:    At least five years of experience working with auditing and/or Financial Reporting, Internal Controls and Compliance.    Experience from Big4    Experience in IFRS reporting, statutory audits and financial statement preparation.    Fluent in English, both spoken and written.We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:    Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.    Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.    Acts with integrity by being straightforward and honest in communication and is easy to get others on board with    Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.    Has interpersonal skills and the ability to create relationships and networks. These skills are needed to work well with our clients, but are of course also important for collaboration within our team.    Is structured, efficient and organized.Recruitment ProcessWe will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.Please attach the following documents to your application:    CVWe believe in having a recruitment process that applies to everyone. As part of the selection, we use psychometric tests to ensure an objective, unbiased, and fair selection.We value the personal meeting to understand the value you can bring to PwC and what we can offer you. The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews. When meeting with HR, you will have a competency-based interview where we examine the personality test you completed before the interview. During the interview with the business, you will have the opportunity to meet with the relevant team to discuss the role. We call for interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions about the job or the recruitment process, contact the responsible recruiter below.At PwC, we help our clients build trust and transform their businesses to enhance competitiveness. We are leaders in tax, audit, and advisory services and are part of a global network with 364,000 employees in 136 countries. By combining our expertise and experience with the latest technology, we assist our clients in becoming more efficient, adapting to changes, and always staying ahead.PwC Sweden is an independent legal entity with over 3,000 employees across the country. Want to know more about PwC? Visit us at pwc.se or on LinkedIn.

title: Front Office Duty Manager till Sheraton Stockholm
description: Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.  The hotel has just completed a full renovation and we are now looking for a new member to join our Front Office Team as Duty Manager. As Duty Manager, you are responsible for overseeing the daily operations and ensure delivery of high-quality service at every touchpoint, creating a seamless and exceptional experience for all guests.  This role involves leading the front office associates, managing check-ins and check-outs, handling guest inquiries and complaints, and collaborating with other departments to maintain smooth operations. A strong focus on delivering exceptional customer service and optimizing efficiency is key to success in this position. You will actively work with guest feedback to continuously enhance their experience. If you are ready to take the next step in your career, this position is a great opportunity to move forward and develop further, both within Front Office and across other areas of the hotel.Your Key Responsibilities:    Manage daily front office operations, including scheduling and training.    Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction assuring personalized service and addressing guest concerns/needs promptly.    Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth operations.    Oversee check-in/check-out procedures and ensure adherence to company policies. Your Qualifications:    Minimum of 3 years of experience in the hotel industry.    At least 1 years of team management experience in a leadership role in guest service or equivalent.    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written; additional languages are a plus.    Ability to motivate and inspire the team.    Proactive and independent work approach.    Values active involvement in daily operations and considers leading the team essential.    Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on guest needs and expectations.    Strong communication and interpersonal skills.    Ability to handle high-pressure situations with professionalism.    Thrives doing operational work and engaging with guests We offer:     A permanent, full-time position following a 6-month probation period and in accordance with the collective agreement.    This position offers great opportunities to develop and take the next step in your career, both within Front Office and across other areas of the hotel.    A dynamic and inclusive work environment.    Employee discounted rates at over 9,000 hotels worldwide.  Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible. Welcome to submit your application to Sheraton Stockholm Hotel! The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.Redefining the Essence of Hospitality We are in the end of a  renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm.  This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

title: Vi söker elektriker / We are looking for electricians
description: Om SMS group / About SMS group SvenskaSMS group är världsledande när det gäller framtidsinriktade teknologier och enastående service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på mer än 4 miljarder euro. Vi tillämpar våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.EnglishSMS group is a global leader in pioneering technologies and outstanding services for the metals industry. In 2024, our team of more than 13,500 employees worldwide generated sales of over €4 billion. We draw on 150 years of experience and our digital expertise to continuously provide the industry with innovative products and processes that extend beyond our core business. We are the right partner for challenging projects, supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their plants and equipment. Our clear goal is to pave the way for a carbon-neutral and sustainable metals industry.Om Rollen / About the roleSvenska:Som elektriker hos oss kommer du att arbeta med både låg- och högspänningsarbeten, främst riktade mot vår maskinpark som inkluderar utrustning såsom slip- och fräsmaskiner. Du kommer att vara ansvarig för underhåll och felsökning av elektriska system och instrument för att säkerställa optimal drift och säkerhet. Arbetet kräver att du har en gedigen förståelse för elektriska kretsar och komponenter samt en förmåga att arbeta med komplexa maskiner.English:As an electrician with us you will work with both low- and high-voltage tasks, primarily focused on our machinery fleet which includes equipment such as grinding and milling machines. You will be responsible for maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical systems and instruments to ensure optimal operation and safety. The role requires a solid understanding of electrical circuits and components as well as the ability to work with complex machines.Din profil / Your profileSvenskaVi söker dig som har god erfarenhet av rollen som elektriker och är bekväm med att arbeta med både maskiner så som Roll Grinding och CNC maskiner samt ställverk inom tung industri.Du arbetar systematiskt vid felsökning, oavsett om det handlar om automationssystem eller maskiner och använder dig av olika verktyg så som ritningar och elscheman för att sätta dig in i systemet/maskinens funktion och konstruktion.Du har gymnasieexamen inom el och automation, alternativt likvärdig yrkesutbildning eller erfarenhet. Det är viktigt att du har den certifiering som krävs för att kunna utföra el arbetet. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att jobba i underhållssystem.Personliga egenskaper som vi värdesätter inkluderar noggrannhet, problemlösningsförmåga och en stark ansvarskänsla. Du bör också ha förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team, samt vara flexibel och anpassningsbar till förändringar i arbetsmiljön. Du är bekväm med att uttrycka dig på svenska och/eller engelska och förstår vikten av säkerhetsföreskrifter för att skapa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö.Du är en person som tar initiativ och bidrar aktivt till att förbättra och effektivisera våra arbetssätt och processer.EnglishWe are looking for someone with several years’ experience as an electrician and who is comfortable working with both machinery such as Roll Grinding and CNC as well as switchgears in heavy industry.You work systematically when troubleshooting, whether you are dealing with automation systems or machines. It is natural for you to use tools such as drawings and electrical schematics to understand the system/machine function and design.You have a secondary school diploma in electrical engineering and automation, or equivalent vocational training or experience. It is important that you have the correct cridentials to be allowed by Swedish authorities to work on electrical tasks. Experience using maintenance management systems is an advantage.Personal qualities we value include precision, problem-solving ability and a strong sense of responsibility. You should be able to work both independently and as part of a team. It is important that you are flexible and adaptable to changes in the work environment. You are proactive and contribute actively to improving and streamlining our work methods and processes. It is a must that you are comfortable expressing yourself in Swedish and/or English and understand the importance of safety regulations to create a safe working environment for yourself and your teammates.You are a person who takes initiative and actively contributes to improving and streamlining our ways of working and processes.Vad vi erbjuder / What we offerSvenskaMed SMS group hittar du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är vad vi lovar våra kunder och anställda nu och i framtiden.EnglishWith SMS group you will find international career opportunities. Our values ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE and SUCCEED have always been an integral part of our work and are what we promise our customers and employees now and in the future.Är detta för dig? / Could this be for you?SvenskaVill du vara med och forma framtiden tillsammans med oss? Skicka gärna in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev. Har du några frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss. Observera att urvalet sker löpande under ansökningsperioden och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.EnglishAre you keen on shaping the future with us? If so, feel free to send us your application of a CV and personal letter. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Please note that the selection process is ongoing during the application period, and that the postion maby be filled before the application deadline.

title: People Partner
description: About the roleGreat deliveries start with great teams. We’re looking for a People Partner who wants to help build both.Based at Instabee’s HQ in Stockholm, you’ll partner with leaders across Customer Service and the other support functions within our Swedish organisation. From helping managers grow into confident leaders to shaping teams and making everyday people decisions, you’ll work close to the business and see the impact of what you do.This is a broad, hands-on role with room to influence. You’ll move between longer-term priorities and the situations that need your attention today, bringing sound judgement, structure, and a practical approach to both.Your future teamYou’ll report directly to our Head of People Sweden and be part of the Swedish People team, alongside our Head of People and three People Partners supporting our operational organisation across Sweden. Together, you’ll share knowledge, tackle challenges, and develop how we work with People across the Swedish business. You’ll also be part of Instabee’s wider People & Culture team, collaborating with colleagues across our markets to exchange ideas, learn from each other, and bring shared People initiatives to life.Some of the things you will do    Act as a trusted partner: Advise and challenge leaders, translating business needs into practical People initiatives.    Enable leadership: Coach managers in performance, feedback, team development, and everyday leadership.    Drive core People processes: Lead salary reviews, performance management, talent reviews, and engagement initiatives within your functions.    Lead change: Support workforce planning and organisational development, helping leaders and teams navigate new ways of working.    Manage employee relations: Guide leaders through employee matters, union dialogue, and negotiations in line with Swedish labour law and relevant collective agreements.    Strengthen the employee experience: Partner with Talent Acquisition and leaders on hiring, onboarding, and retention, while supporting a healthy and sustainable work environment.What we’re looking forYou’re an experienced People professional who enjoys being close to the business. You can connect the bigger picture to a manager’s next decision, and you’re just as comfortable challenging a proposal as you are helping put it into practice.You bring empathy, integrity, and the confidence to take a clear position. When priorities shift, you stay focused on what matters and help others move forward. You’re curious about how technology and data can improve the way we work, and you enjoy building solutions that people actually use.We believe you bring:    At least 5 years of experience as a People Partner/HR Business Partner, independently supporting and advising leaders across a broad People agenda.    Strong practical knowledge of Swedish labour law and collective agreements, with experience independently managing complex employee relations matters and union negotiations.    Proven experience coaching and challenging managers, driving core People processes, and supporting organisational change.    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and judgement to influence decisions and balance business and employee needs.    A bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology, or a related field.    Fluency in Swedish and English.What you’ll getA role with real ownership, close access to business leaders, and the opportunity to shape how our Swedish organisation develops.You’ll join a People team with colleagues to learn from, exchange ideas with, and tackle challenges alongside. There’s plenty to build and improve, and your ideas will have room to become action.If you enjoy a quick pace, care about making leadership better, and want to see your work make a difference in a technology-enabled delivery business, we’d love to meet you.Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:    🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. title: (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Analytics

description: Job ID: 7171 Do you enjoy advanced data analysis and solving complex problems? title: Data Controller
description: Job description:Trading Analytics and Flow Quality● Traffic profitability metrics: spread and commission revenue, PnL by book, and all Total PnLmetrics, broken down by instrument, region, traffic source and partner.● Toxic flow detection: latency arbitrage, scalping, exploitation of swaps and price gaps, and coordinated client groups.● Analytical support for A/B-book routing: which clients to route to the market and on what criteria, with measurement of the actual effect of each decision, and monitoring of the hedge position. Partners and CPA● A multi-level evaluation model for partners and introducing brokers (IBs).● Detection of CPA abuse and of abuse in revenue-share payouts.● Partner tiering and the economic rationale for the terms of each tier. Payments and Financial Reconciliation● Payment flow analytics: deposit conversion by payment service provider (PSP), declines, processing costs and withdrawal times.● Detection of payment abuse: AML patterns in deposits and withdrawals, chargeback risk and mismatches between account holders and payment details.● Reconciliation of internal records with providers and financial reporting, with automatic detection of discrepancies.● A single source of truth for revenue, agreed with Finance. Marketing and Client Analytics● End-to-end funnel from lead to registration, first-time deposit (FTD), active trader and retention, with accurate attribution by channel.● Acquisition economics: CAC, LTV and cohort payback by channel and region, and assessment of lead quality at an early stage rather than after three months.● Analytics of the retention and conversion teams: effectiveness, workload and impact on client retention.● Segmentation of the client base and data support for campaigns. Compliance and AML● Dashboards and alerting in line with regulatory requirements and internal policies.● Analytical support for KYC and AML: client risk scoring, monitoring of suspicious patterns and preparation of data for reporting.● Responding to regulator requests using a reproducible calculation methodology. Platform and Data● Ownership of the data stack: storage (Snowflake, MySQL, ClickHouse), orchestration, transformations, dbt, Dagster, BI (Tableau, Hex), and integrations with the trading platforms (MT5 and proprietary), CRM, PSPs and advertising accounts.● A data model covering trading, clients, payments and marketing in a single consistent logic.● Data quality: tests, data freshness SLAs and monitoring of integration failures.● Governance: metrics glossary, data owners, access control and GDPR requirements.● Connection graph methodology for identifying linked accounts and groups.● The risk admin panel (an internal Data product) as a single risk-processing platform: alerts, transaction monitoring and client restrictions. Team Management● Managing and developing the team, including hiring, grades, objectives and the bonus system.● Quarterly planning and prioritisation, protecting the team from continuous ad hoc requests while maintaining good relationships with the business.● Organising the team's work as a service with clear SLAs rather than a queue of individual requests.

You will contribute to identifying misconduct, compliance breaches, fraud risks, conflicts of interest, and other irregularities through structured investigation methods and strong professional judgment. for remedial, corrective, or disciplinary actions where appropriate.• Draft investigation reports, closure statements, presentations, and summaries for internal stakeholders.• Present investigation findings and status updates in a timely, clear, and professional manner.• Support the investigation team throughout all investigation phases and advise on related compliance, governance, and process report-writing and presentation skills.• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact with a wide range of stakeholders and handle difficult situations professionally.• Fluency in written and spoken English and Swedish. Um sie dabei zu unterstützen, sucht das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) **per 1\. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung** eine:n Regional Fundraising Delegate für Südasien. Bangladesch und des Kreuzes in Nepal bei der Entwicklung und Einführung nachhaltiger Fundraising\-Systeme, mit Fokus auf Mittelbeschaffung und Spenderbindung* Betreuung von Fundraising\-Teams in den der Projektberichterstattung und am Wissensaustausch innerhalb der Region### Das bringen Sie mit* Hochschulabschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation oder Fundraising mit mind. fünf Jahren nachgewiesener unternehmen* Vertrautheit mit CRM\-Systemen für Fundraising\-Aktivitäten inkl. title: AUTOMATIKER/IN EFZ
description: Securecell ist ein Schweizer Technologieunternehmen an der Schnittstelle von Biotechnologie, Ingenieurwesen und Gesundheitswesen. Seit mehr als drei Jahrzehnten entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen, die wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen voranbringen und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Durch die Kombination aus umfassender Expertise in der Bioprozesskontrolle und einer ausgeprägten Innovationskultur arbeiten wir interdisziplinär zusammen, um komplexe Herausforderungen in praktische Technologien zu verwandeln, die einen echten Mehrwert schaffen. Im Rahmen unseres nachhaltigen Innovations- und Wachstumskurses suchen wir eine/nAUTOMATIKER/IN EFZ für unser Manufacturing- und Supply-Chain-Team.DIE CHANCEDies ist mehr als nur ein Job. Es ist die Möglichkeit, zu Technologien beizutragen, die bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen unterstützen und die Zukunft der Biotechnologie und des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten. Als Mitglied unseres Manufacturing- und Supply-Chain-Teams spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung, Verifizierung und dem Lebenszyklusmanagement von Automationslösungen für innovative Steuerungen, die in der Biopharmazie  eingesetzt werden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Expertinnen und Experten aus unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen wirken Sie an anspruchsvollen Projekten mit, entwickeln innovative Lösungen und tragen dazu bei, Produkte bereitzustellen, die für unsere Kunden weltweit Mehrwert schaffen. Unabhängig davon, ob Sie bestehende Technologien verbessern, Innovationen vorantreiben oder komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen – Ihr Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss auf unseren Erfolg und unser zukünftiges Wachstum. IHRE AUFGABEN•    Montage, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Maschinen und Anlagen gemäss den technischen Spezifikationen und Plänen. •    Diagnose und Behebung von Störungen und Fehlfunktionen an Anlagen durch Analyse von technischen Dokumentationen, Fehlersuche und Reparaturarbeiten.•    Umsetzung von Verbesserungsvorschlägen zur Optimierung der Effizienz, Leistung und Sicherheit von Systemen. •    Dokumentation von Reparaturen und Änderungen an den Anlagen gemäss den geltenden Richtlinien und Vorschriften.•    Mitarbeit in Entwicklungsprojekten zur Konzeption und Realisierung neuer automatisierter Systeme und Prozesse.•    Erstellung von E-Plänen für elektrische Schaltungen und Steuerungssysteme unter Berücksichtigung der aktuellen Normen und Vorschriften. •    Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Fachkräften und Abteilungen, um reibungslose Abläufe und einen effektiven Informationsaustausch zu gewährleisten. WER SIE SINDSie haben Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, und fühlen sich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Elektronik, Embedded Software, Sensortechnologien und medizinische Innovation zusammenkommen. Sie sind proaktiv, praxisorientiert und motiviert, Technologien weiterzuentwickeln, die die Überwachung von Blutparametern und die Diabetesversorgung verbessern. Sie arbeiten auch unter Druck souverän, bewegen sich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hoher Sichtbarkeit gegenüber dem Senior Management und arbeiten gerne in funktionsübergreifenden sowie agilen Teams.IHR PROFIL•    Abgeschlossene EFZ-Grundausbildung in Elektrotechnik, Automation oder Mechatronik. •    Ein Abschluss in Automatisierungstechnik auf Stufe FH oder HF ist von Vorteil. •    Gute Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck effektiv zu arbeiten. •    Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit an Entwicklungsprojekten und Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil. •    Umgang mit E-Plan oder ähnlicher Software zur Erstellung von elektrischen Schaltplänen. •    Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. •    Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsgeschick und selbständige und verantwortungsvolle Arbeitsweise. •    Fundierte PC-Kenntnisse im MS Office und eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. WAS SIE ERFOLGREICH MACHT•    Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Montage, Wartung und Reparatur von automatisierten Anlagen und Maschinen.•    Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Steuerungs- und Regelungssystemen (z.B. SPS-Programmierung).•    Vertrautheit mit elektrischen, mechanischen und pneumatischen Komponenten sowie mit industriellen Sensoren und Aktuatoren.•    Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Schaltpläne und Dokumentationen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.WARUM SIE GERNE BEI SECURECELL ARBEITEN WERDENEinen Unterschied machen: Ihre Arbeit trägt zu innovativen Technologien bei, die wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt ermöglichen, die Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern und reale Herausforderungen lösen.Mit aussergewöhnlichen Menschen arbeiten: Werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams aus talentierten Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Softwareentwicklern und Business-Professionals, die Innovation und Zusammenarbeit leben.Ihre Karriere weiterentwickeln: Wir fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und bieten Möglichkeiten, neue Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, Ihr Fachwissen auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.Jeden Tag innovativ sein: Arbeiten Sie an modernsten Projekten mit und helfen Sie dabei, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Grenzen von Biotechnologie, Automatisierung und Medizintechnologie erweitern.Verantwortung übernehmen: Wir glauben, dass grossartige Ideen von überall kommen können. Sie profitieren von einem hohen Mass an Verantwortung, Selbstständigkeit und der Möglichkeit, sichtbar etwas zu bewegen.Eine kollaborative Kultur erleben: Unser Erfolg basiert auf Teamarbeit, Wissensaustausch, gegenseitigem Respekt und einer echten Leidenschaft dafür, komplexe Herausforderungen gemeinsam zu lösen.Teil unserer Wachstumsgeschichte sein: Werden Sie Teil eines wachsenden Schweizer Technologieunternehmens, in dem Innovation, Unternehmergeist und langfristiges Denken im Mittelpunkt stehen.WAS WIR BIETENMit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem Mitarbeitende Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und sichtbar Wirkung erzielen können. Unsere Kultur basiert auf Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung. Dadurch kann jedes Teammitglied aktiv die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens und der Branchen, in denen wir tätig sind, mitgestalten. Ergänzend dazu bieten wir:•    Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung entsprechend Ihrer Erfahrung und Ihrem Beitrag•    Umfassendes Benefit-Paket zur Unterstützung Ihres Wohlbefindens•    Grosszügiger Ferienanspruch, flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Hybrid- oder Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten•    Flexible Urlaubs- und Abwesenheitsregelungen zur Förderung der Work-Life-Balance•    Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Schulungen, Mentoring und praktische Erfahrungen•    Möglichkeiten zur Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kunden und Partnern•    Attraktiver Standort mit direkter Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, kostenlosen Parkplätzen in der Tiefgarage sowie kostenlosem Kaffee und Mineralwasser•    Private Unfallversicherung und bezahlte Freistellung für frischgebackene Eltern•    Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramme (je nach Anspruchsberechtigung)•    Regelmässige Teamevents und Firmenveranstaltungen zur Stärkung des Zusammenhalts und zum gemeinsamen Feiern von ErfolgenARBEITSORT Diese Position ist am Hauptsitz der Securecell AG in Urdorf (Zürich), Schweiz, angesiedelt.INTERESSIERT?Wir freuen uns darauf, mehr über Sie zu erfahren! Bitte reichen Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen einschliesslich Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen und Referenzen über unser Karriereportal unter www.securecell.ch/jobs ein und teilen Sie uns in 2 bis 3 Sätzen mit, was Sie an unserem Unternehmen und dieser Position besonders anspricht.

Sie sorgen dafür, dass die Schweizer Armee sowie andere Einsatz\- und Sicherheitsorganisationen ihre Aufgaben jederzeit umfassend wahrnehmen können.ICT System Specialist C5I100Thun**Das kannst du bewegen*** Verantwortung für den sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, die Wartung und die Weiterentwicklung sicherheitsrelevanter Systeme und Services* Betreuung und Administration von Client\- und Server\-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von Windows und Linux sowie von virtualisierten Umgebungen* Durchführung systematischer Fehleranalysen und Auswertung von System\- und Logdaten für die Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen* Installation, Konfiguration und Wartung von Software und Fachapplikationen* Durchführung von Softwareaktualisierungen und Sicherstellung des Patch\- und Release\-Managements sowie von Sicherheitsmassnahmen* Überwachung, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Betriebsprozessen mithilfe geeigneter Skript\- und Automatisierungslösungen* Mitarbeit im Incident Management sowie technischer Support remote und vor Ort* Erstellung und Pflege von Betriebshandbüchern, technischen Dokumentationen und Checklisten**Das bringst du mit*** Ausbildung oder höhere Berufsbildung im Bereich Informatik, alternativ Quereinstieg mit vergleichbarer Berufserfahrung* Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse im Bereich Betriebssysteme, insbesondere Windows und Linux* Kenntnisse in der IT\-Sicherheit, insbesondere in der Absicherung von IT\-Systemen und Netzwerken* Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools wie z. B. Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir sind stets auf der Suche nach talentierten und motivierten Personen, die unser Team bereichern möchten. Wir legen grossen Wert auf Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit und unser Ziel ist es, ein vielfältiges Team aufzubauen, in dem alle ihre persönlichen Stärken voll entfalten können. Wir ermutigen insbesondere alle Personen, unabhängig von ihrem Geschlecht, die möglicherweise Bedenken haben, eine Stelle in einem armeenahen Umfeld anzunehmen, sich zu bewerben.**Über den Bereich**Die Business Area C5I der RUAG MRO Holding AG unterstützt die Schweizer Armee bei der Realisierung von IKT\-Projekten mit spezifischem Fokus auf das Kommando Cyber. Hier kannst du an vorderster Front bei der Digitalisierung der Schweizer Armee mitarbeiten. Willst du einen Beitrag zum sicherheitspolitischen Umfeld leisten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir arbeiten agil und richten uns konsequent nach dem DevSecOps\-Modell aus.  Mit dem C5I\-Campus haben wir einen Innovationsraum für hochsichere IT\-Systeme geschaffen und bieten attraktivste Arbeitsplätze. Darum bieten wir unter anderem flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice\-Optionen an.Wir bieten dir ein leistungsorientiertes\- und marktgerechtes Salär, 13 Monatslöhne sowie grosszügige Prämien\- und Zulagen. Zusammen mit weiteren Nebenleistungen ergibt sich daraus ein attraktives Gesamtpaket.**Flexibles Arbeiten****Vergünstigungen**Bei RUAG profitierst du von Vergünstigungen in den Bereichen Mobilität und Verpflegung. title: Quality Assurance Inspector (m/f/d/x)
description: Let’s bring quality, safety, and sustainability to life together!Intertek makes our world a little better every day! A job at Intertek offers a great opportunity to work alongside 46,000 colleagues worldwide to continuously improve the safety, quality, and sustainability of products. Through our services, we support our clients across a wide range of industries in more than 1,000 laboratories worldwide.Intertek Government and Trade Services helps governments, customs authorities, and standards organizations ensure that imported goods meet international safety and quality standards. We help protect the public and the environment from non-compliant products, secure import duties, and ensure smooth customs clearance and international trade.For a position in German-speaking Switzerland, We are seeking a Quality Assurance Inspector (m/f/d/x) to join our team as soon as possible on a 20–40% basis. The position is offered on a self-employed, independent contractor basis with compensation at an hourly rate.Your Responsibilities-Conducting visual quality inspections of goods, materials, and shipments to identify defects, damage, or deviations-Taking product samples in accordance with specified inspection requirements-Verifying quantities, batches, and piece counts based on the provided documentation-Documenting inspection results using specified checklists and creating comprehensive photographic documentation-Conducting inspections at suppliers’, customers’, or transit locations within the assigned region-Ensuring compliance with internal quality, safety, and inspection standardsYour Profile-Education or degree in a science-related field (e.g., chemistry, biology, or a comparable discipline)-Valid driver’s license and willingness to undertake regular regional business trips-Excellent written and spoken German and English skills-Good IT user skills-Strong observational skills, high attention to detail, and an independent and structured approach to work-High commitment to quality, a strong sense of responsibility, and integrityYour Benefits-Our open corporate culture with flat hierarchies offers plenty of room for your ideas-You’ll work in a dynamic team as part of an international company-With flexible flex time, annual work hours, we prioritize work-life balance and the ability to balance family -and career-We are committed to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity-We value differences, actively promote inclusion, and create an environment that fosters each person’s individuality in the best interest of the company.Interested and motivated?Then please submit your detailed application materials online, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations!

title: Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux - solutions B2B
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux - solutions B2B--- Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux \- solutions B2B=====================================================Chez ello, notre vision est de faire du monde digital une expérience humaine. Connecter est notre métier. Notre secteur d’activité, les télécommunications, nous plonge dans un univers stimulant où se construisent les technologies du futur. Nous sommes le fournisseur de connectivité leader de Neuchâtel et partenaire de Sunrise. Au cœur du digital, notre objectif est clair : offrir une expérience clientèle incomparable. Rejoins notre équipe en tant que : **Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux – solutions B2B**Avant\-vente, projets et support **Tes missions**Tu aimes autant comprendre les besoins d’un client que résoudre un problème technique ? Chez ello, tu combines infrastructure IT, applications métiers et accompagnement des entreprises.* Tu participes à l’avant\-vente B2B : analyse des besoins, présentation des solutions et contribution au chiffrage.* Tu pilotes les projets techniques confiés et accompagnes les clients de la mise en service au support.* Tu secondes le responsable qualité dans la maintenance des applications métiers et les tests des mises à jour.* Tu exploites notre IT interne et assures sa sécurité, sa disponibilité et le support aux utilisateur·trices.* Tu participes au piquet de niveau 1 pour les réseaux backbone et HFC et les clients B2B sous contrat 24/7 : diagnostic, orientation des tickets et premiers dépannages réseau autorisés. **Ton profil et ta personnalité*** Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en administration et exploitation d’infrastructures : Windows/Linux, virtualisation, stockage et postes de travail.* Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux réseau (TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, DNS/DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi, pare\-feu), la configuration des équipements et le diagnostic des incidents.* Tu sais sécuriser les accès et assurer les mises à jour, la supervision, les sauvegardes et la restauration des services.* Tu comprends les applications métiers et les services web et de messagerie, avec des bases en SQL et en scripts.* Autonome et méthodique, tu sais prioriser, documenter et escalader. À l’aise avec les clients, tu aimes expliquer la technique et souhaites t’impliquer dans l’avant\-vente et les projets B2B.* Cisco CCNA ou compétences équivalentes souhaitées. Des connaissances Cisco/Meraki et M\-Files sont des atouts.* Tu aimes apprendre et élargir tes compétences. Ouvert·e aux nouvelles approches, tu partages tes idées et proposes des améliorations concrètes. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre :**Chez ello, nous évoluons dans un secteur essentiel. Notre réseau fait fonctionner les entreprises, soigner les hôpitaux, enseigner les écoles et connecte chacun à ses proches. Employeur moderne et certifié « Great Place to Work », nous créons un environnement de travail basé sur la confiance et la responsabilisation. Travailler chez ello, c’est incarner notre mentalité basée sur la fiabilité, la détermination, l’ouverture, l’accessibilité et l’empathie. Nous sommes une PME où la polyvalence est essentielle : pas de routine, mais des défis variés et une vraie marge de manœuvre. Tu travailleras dans nos bureaux avec une vue imprenable sur le lac de Neuchâtel. Tu pourras te changer les idées dans notre salle de repos et profiter de la possibilité de faire du télétravail et du remote office. Nous aimons passer du temps ensemble, c’est pour cela que notre comité festif organise des événements mensuels. **Ta postulation :**Si notre offre d’emploi a éveillé ton intérêt, nous t’invitons à nous transmettre ton dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail et diplômes/attestations) sur le site   . Nous nous engageons à te donner une réponse qu’elle amène à une rencontre ou à un remerciement de nous avoir considéré comme employeur. Par ailleurs, sois assuré·e que nous accordons une importance primordiale à garantir un processus de recrutement juste et équitable. Notre démarche de recrutement est simple, transparente et orientée vers l’échange : notre objectif est de mieux nous connaître pour envisager une collaboration qui a du sens pour toi comme pour nous.![ello communications S.A.]()* ello communications S.A.  Av. \- 20  2000 Neuchâtel*jid3391ad7jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

Collaborateur·trice commercial·e et événementiel à 80 %
============================================================

**Vous aimez le contact humain, l'organisation et les événements ? Vous avez un esprit commercial et une touche de créativité ? Alors cette opportunité est peut\-être faite pour vous !**

Situé dans un cadre exceptionnel au bord du lac de Neuchâtel, Le Camp à Vaumarcus accueille tout au long de l'année des groupes, des entreprises, des associations et des particuliers pour des séjours, des séminaires et différents événements.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personne dynamique, polyvalente et autonome pour assurer le suivi commercial de nos clients ainsi que participer au développement de notre communication et à l'organisation de nos événements.

**Vos missions**

**Gestion commerciale (60 %)**

* Traiter les demandes de renseignements et de réservations.
* Établir les offres et les contrats de location.
* Assurer le suivi des réservations et la confirmation des contrats.
* Conseiller et accompagner les clients tout au long du processus de réservation.
* Organiser et réaliser les visites des lieux avec les clients potentiels.
* Recherche de nouveaux clients et promotion des prestations du Camp.
* Assurer la coordination des informations entre les différents services.
* Préparer les dossiers d'accueil et assurer la remise des locaux aux groupes.
* Contrôler les locaux lors du départ des groupes.
* Assurer la séance d'information du lundi avec les clients.
* Assurer la permanence téléphonique et le traitement des demandes.
* Effectuer diverses tâches administratives.


**Communication et événementiel (20 %)**

* Participer à la conception, à l'organisation et à la coordination des événements du Camp (repas dégustation, repas de chasse, marché de Noël et autres événements).
* Participer à l'organisation et au suivi des séminaires et événements d'entreprises.
* Assurer la communication et la promotion des événements.
* Gérer et animer les réseaux sociaux (Facebook, Instagram et LinkedIn).
* Créer des contenus et des supports de communication (affiches, visuels, presse, etc.).
* Participer à la mise à jour du site internet.
* Participer à la coordination logistique et à la mise en place des événements.
* Élaborer et assurer le suivi des questionnaires de satisfaction.


**Votre profil**

* Formation commerciale, événementielle ou administrative.
* Aisance relationnelle et sens du service à la clientèle.
* Bonnes capacités organisationnelles et autonomie.
* Intérêt pour la communication et le marketing.
* Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et des réseaux sociaux.
* Sensibilité visuelle et intérêt pour la création de contenus visuels et de supports de communication.
* Esprit d'équipe et polyvalence.
* Flexibilité et disponibilité pour travailler les week\-ends (minimum 1x par mois).
* Excellente maîtrise du français. L'allemand et l'anglais sont des atouts.


**Nous vous offrons**

Nous vous proposons un poste varié et polyvalent au sein d'une structure à taille humaine, dans un cadre de travail agréable au bord du lac de Neuchâtel. Vous bénéficierez d'une activité diversifiée alliant commerce, relation clientèle, communication et événementiel, avec une certaine autonomie dans l'organisation et la réalisation de vos tâches, au sein d'une équipe dynamique et engagée.

**Conditions du poste**

* **Lieu de travail :** Le Camp, Vaumarcus (NE)
* **Taux d'activité :** 80 % (33 h 35 par semaine)
* **Entrée en fonction :** De suite, à convenir
* **Horaires :** Horaires adaptables selon les besoins de l'activité et des événements. Un week\-end de permanence par mois minimum, selon un planning établi à l'avance.
