Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa (5 Sterne Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5 Sterne Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3 Sterne) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz – eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarungeine/n Front Office Agent 100 % (w/m/i) Aufgaben: - Durchführen von Check-In/Check-Out unter Einhaltung der LQA Standards- Anreisevorbereitung auf täglicher Basis- Bearbeiten von täglichen Checklisten der Rezeption- Verkauf von Hotelgutscheinen- Erfassen von Reservationen für Zimmer und Restaurants am Desk- aktiver Zusatzverkauf [mit attraktiver Gewinnbeteiligung]- Vorbeugen und Handeln von Gästebeschwerden in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Senior Leadership Team des Front Office- Annahme von In Room Dining Bestellungen- Annahme und Koordination von diversen Gästeanfragen- Arbeiten im Früh-/Mittel-/Spätdienst mit einzelnen Einsätzen im NachtdienstSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im administrativen Bereich. - Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrungen im Tourismus oder in der Hotellerie mit. Deutsch, Englisch und vorzugsweise auch Französisch beherrschen Sie fliessend in Wort und Schrift. - Schicht- und Wochenendarbeiten sind für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind sehr flexibel und belastbar und arbeiten auch unter Zeit- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und effizient. Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA-Checks.Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.Auszeichnungen:Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»World Spa Awards Switzerland’s Best Hotel Spa 2025LHW Membership Awards Sustainability LeaderGreat Place To Work 2025The New York Times’52 Places to Go in 2018Travel + Leisure 500 List 2021Handelszeitung Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023 Connoisseur Circle Best Gourmet HotelMICHELIN Wellness Award Best Wellness HotelGALA Spa Awards Best Spa ConceptMICHELIN Keys 3/3 Keys

title: ACCOUNTANT ASSISTANT – AP (50%)
description: ETEL worldwide leader in the development and manufacturing of high-performance motion control components and high-end mechatronic motion systems based in Môtiers. We currently call upon a growing diversity of skills which take part in the exciting adventure of our international activity. Contribute to our growth!We are looking for :- A motivated and curious team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills, eager to develop their expertise in the field of accounting.We offer you :- A challenging position in a modern and innovative midsize company operating in an international environment- Competitive compensation and excellent working conditions- A dynamic environment with advanced digital tools and processesYour MissionAs a member of the Finance team, you will support the accounts payable activities and contribute to the smooth running of day-to-day accounting operations. Your key responsibilities will include:- Enter, review, and monitor supplier invoices, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulations- Support the preparation of supplier payments and monitor payment due dates to optimize cash flow management- Manage employee expense claims, including verification, approval, and integration into the accounting system- Ensure accurate accounting allocation of supplier invoices and expense claims within the ERP system- Participate in accounts payable reconciliations and related control activities- Assist with month-end and year-end closing processes- Ensure compliance with internal control requirements and accounting procedures- Support the continuous improvement of accounts payable processes and workflows- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve invoice and payment-related queries- Provide administrative and accounting support to the Finance team as requiredYour Profile- Commercial CFC or equivalent qualification- 2 to 3 years of professional experience in accounting, ideally in an industrial environment- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel- Experience with an ERP system would be an advantage- Basic knowledge of Swiss GAAP and IFRS accounting standards- Fluent in French with a good command of English, both written and spokenDo you want to take up this challenge?We look forward to receiving your application at jobs@etel.ch

combines technical understanding of vehicle body repair with leadership and customer\-focused coordination.* Experience in managing or coordinating operations in a vehicle body repair workshop or a comparable automotive environment.* Knowledge of collision repair, vehicle damage assessment, repair planning and quality control.* Ability to schedule work, allocate resources and balance workshop capacity with delivery deadlines.* Leadership skills for guiding employees, setting priorities and addressing operational issues.* Strong communication skills for working with customers, insurers, suppliers and internal teams.* Commercial awareness and the ability to monitor costs, productivity and key performance indicators (KPIs).* Structured, solution\-oriented and dependable working methods, with a strong focus on safety and quality.### ApplicationWe invite you to apply through this job ad and look forward to learning more about your experience and motivation for joining title: Infimier
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Infimier(ère)--- Infimier(ère)==============Afin de compléter son équipe infirmière, la Clinic Les Alpes cherche à recruter un(e) infirmier(ère).Dans un cadre exceptionnel, La Clinic Les Alpes est un établissement de soins privé dont la mission est d’accompagner des patients originaires du monde entier, souffrant de problèmes de dépendance avec ou sans substance ainsi que présentant une problématique de santé mentale (trauma, dépression, stress, burn\-out, anxiété, etc.). Infirmier(e) 80 à 100%----------------------- Entrée en fonction : de suite Relevant de l’infirmier chef, les responsabilités et les fonctions essentielles du poste comprennent, sans s’y limiter : **Tâches principales** :* Dispenser des soins relationnels, de médecine intégrative et somatiques afin d’assurer la continuité et la qualité du projet de soins.* Gérer les situations de crise en y apportant une réponse adaptée et adéquate tout en s’appuyant sur les ressources disponibles* Créer, renforcer et maintenir une relation thérapeutique avec des patients aux origines culturelles diverses et variées* Accompagner des patients lors de sorties thérapeutiques, médicales ou récréatives en assurant la fluidité des échanges avec les différents prestataires externes tout en portant le cadre thérapeutique élaboré pour le contexte, nécessitant parfois de devoir se rendre à l’étranger.* Développer en collaboration avec l’infirmier chef et les autres départements des projets d’accompagnements ou d’améliorations continus* Participer activement aux activités de supervision (individuel et d’équipe)* Animer des groupes thérapeutiques et psycho\-éducatifs **Profil recherché :*** Diplôme HES infirmier ou un titre jugé équivalent reconnu par les autorités* Langues parlées çais, Anglais (lu, parlé et écrit) minimum B2* Expérience en psychiatrie et addiction* Ouverture d’esprit, capacité d'écoute et disponibilité* Esprit d’équipe, sens du relationnel* Motivation, autonomie, polyvalence, empathie, rigueur* capacité d’adaptation et d’intégration* Aptitude à collaborer au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire* Sens de la discrétion Vous souhaitez postuler, merci de bien vouloir nous faire parvenir par email votre dossier complet (lettre de motivation, CV, photo, certificats \& diplômes) en français ou anglais à notre service des Ressources Humaines.Seuls les dossiers répondant au profil recherché seront traités. ![Clinique Les Alpes SA]()* Clinique Les Alpes SA  Route de Sonloup 37  1833 Les Avants*jida38e002jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

title: Chef de projet - Solutions énergétiques & stockage
description: Ref 2589262 \| Date: 4 Nov 2026![Viteos Solutions SA]( )*Viteos Solutions SA, filiale de Viteos SA, est dédiée à accompagner les particuliers et les professionnels dans la réalisation de leurs projets énergétiques. Nous mettons un point d'honneur à proposer des services personnalisés, alliant fiabilité, qualité et budget maîtrisé. Grâce à notre expertise, nous offrons des prestations complètes, telles que les panneaux photovoltaïques, les pompes à chaleur, les bornes de recharge ou les installations électriques.*Chef de projet \- Solutions énergétiques \& stockage (100%)**Mets ton énergie au service des solutions de demain !**Tu souhaites contribuer concrètement à la transition énergétique, développer des projets innovants et participer à la croissance d'une entreprise dynamique en Suisse romande ?**Ce qui t'attends\-**  * Piloter des projets énergétiques de A à Z pour notre clientèle privée, les entreprises, les collectivités et nos propres installations de production.* Piloter des projets énergétiques multi\-technologies de A à Z, de la conception au dimensionnement jusqu'à la mise en service : solaire photovoltaïque, stockage d'énergie (dont BESS), pompes à chaleur (PAC) et regroupements dans le cadre de la consommation propre (RCP).* Développer notre activité de stockage d'énergie, notamment les projets de grande capacité.* Coordonner les partenaires et prestataires, en assurant le respect des budgets, des délais et de la qualité.* Contribuer au développement commercial en élaborant des offres et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités.* Faire évoluer nos prestations en proposant de nouvelles solutions adaptées aux besoins du marché et aux innovations technologiques.* Cultiver une relation de proximité et de confiance avec notre clientèle et nos partenaires.**Ton profil*** Formation supérieure technique (HES, EPF, ES ou équivalent) dans les domaines de l'énergie, du génie électrique ou de l'électrotechnique, ou parcours professionnel jugé équivalent.* Expérience confirmée dans les projets photovoltaïques avec stockage et les installations de stockage de grande capacité (BESS).* Maîtrise des outils de dimensionnement et bonne connaissance des normes techniques et électriques suisses.* Solides compétences en gestion de projets, coordination et suivi budgétaire.* Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et sens de l'initiative.* Aisance relationnelle, sens du service et goût du travail en équipe.* Curiosité pour les nouvelles technologies et les enjeux de la title: Médecin chef∙fe de clinique ou chef∙fe de clinique adjoint∙e - Unités hospitalières à 80-100%
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Médecin chef∙fe de clinique ou chef∙fe de clinique adjoint∙e - Unités hospitalières à 80-100% --- Médecin chef∙fe de clinique ou chef∙fe de clinique adjoint∙e \\- Unités hospitalières à 80\\-100% ========================================================================================================= La Fondation de Nant organise l'ensemble des soins psychiatriques publiques de l'Est vaudois. Elle assume une mission de santé publique à la demande de l'Etat de Vaud. Ses services de soins sont ouverts à tous, enfants, adolescents, adultes et personnes âgées habitant les districts d'Aigle, de Lavaux\\-Oron et de la Riviera\\-Pays\\-d'Enhaut. Ils sont proposés par des Psychiatres, des Psychologues, des Infirmiers, des Ergothérapeutes, des Assistants sociaux, des Educateurs et autres professionnels de la santé mentale. La Fondation de Nant est membre de la Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois (FHV), organe faîtier des hôpitaux régionaux vaudois reconnus d'intérêt public. Elle fait également partie du Réseau Santé Haut\\-Léman qui regroupe les partenaires de la santé de la Riviera et du Pays\\-d'Enhaut avec ceux du Chablais vaudois et valaisan. Attachée à la psychanalyse par son histoire, la Fondation de Nant se reconnaît actuellement dans ses développements contemporains. La vision clinique qui en résulte se décline à travers ses pratiques, ses formations et son ouverture aux autres approches. Afin de compléter ses équipes au sein des unités hospitalières de psychiatrie adulte et de psychiatrie de la personne âgée, la Fondation de Nant met au concours des postes de \*\*Médecin chef∙fe de clinique ou chef∙fe de clinique adjoint∙e \\- Unités hospitalières à 80\\-100%\*\* \*\*LA MISSION\*\* Coordonner les activités médicales, cliniques et organisationnelles d'une unité hospitalière du \*\*Service de psychiatrie de psychothérapie de l'Adulte (SPPA)\*\* ou de la \*\*Personne Âgée (SPPPA)\*\*, garantir l'encadrement des médecins assistants et stagiaires, ainsi que coordonner les soins avec les réseaux externes et les proches. \*\*NOUS OFFRONS\*\* La Fondation de Nant est une institution privée reconnue d'intérêt public, chargée par l'Etat d'organiser et de dispenser des soins psychiatriques dans la région de l'Est vaudois. Ses unités hospitalières de psychiatrie adulte et de psychiatrie de la personne âgée accueillent des patients nécessitant une prise en charge psychiatrie stationnaire adaptée à leurs besoins. L'hôpital adulte peut accueillir jusqu'à 50 patients âgés entre 18 et 65 ans répartis sur 4 unités, souffrant de troubles psychiatriques. L'hôpital pour la personne âgée peut accueillir jusqu'à 18 patients de plus de 65 ans. Être chef∙fe de clinique ou chef∙fe de clinique adjoint∙e dans ces services, c'est évoluer dans une fonction d'\*\*encadrement\*\* et de \*\*formation\*\* au sein d'une \*\*équipe pluridisciplinaire\*\*. C'est également contribuer à une approche des soins fondée sur la \*\*relation\*\* avec les patients, leurs proches et les différents partenaires du réseau. \*\*NOUS CHERCHONS\*\* Une personne avancée dans sa formation en \*\*psychiatrie et psychothérapie\*\* avec ou sans titre FMH (titre étranger avec reconnaissance MEBEKO), qui peut attester d'une expérience en psychiatrie adulte ou en psychiatrie de la personne âgée et souhaitant mettre ses compétences au bénéfice des \*\*soins psychiatriques hospitaliers\*\*. De plus, nous recherchons une personne ayant la capacité à s'engager dans un \*\*processus relationnel\*\*, aimant le \*\*travail\*\*\*\*interdisciplinaire\*\* et ayant une grande \*\*autonomie\*\*. \*\*Entrée en fonction\*\* Mai 2027 \*\*Conditions d'engagement\*\* Selon la Convention Collective de Travail dans le secteur parapublic vaudois. \*\*Lieu de travail\*\* Corsier\\-sur\\-Vevey \*\*Renseignements auprès de\*\* Katia Hächler, Psychologue du travail : \*\*Dans la mesure où toutes nos candidatures sont traitées de manière électronique, nous vous remercions de postuler exclusivement par internet, en nous adressant, au minimum, un curriculum vitae accompagné d'une lettre de motivation\*\* Plus d'informations sur !\[Fondation de Nant\]( ) \* Fondation de Nant Rte de Nant 1804 Corsier s/Vevey \* \[ \](\< \>) jpidc2e73eejm jpit1145jm jpiy26jm

Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:   *Swiss Location Awards **«Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»***   *World Spa Awards **«Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»***   *LHW Membership Awards **«Sustainability Leader»***   *Great Place To Work 2025*   *The New York Times'**«52 Places to Go in 2018»***   *Travel \+ Leisure **«500 List 2021»***   *Handelszeitung **«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»***   *Connoisseur Circle **«Best Gourmet Hotel»***   *MICHELIN Wellness Award **«Best Wellness Hotel»***   *GALA Spa Awards **«Best Spa Concept»***   *MICHELIN Keys **«3/3 Keys»***    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Koch  HR Assistant  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jidbd82397jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

BAM is a service organization that has four teams situated across Europe and North America and that uses global capabilities with local support structures to  drive integrated biological specimen solutions that accelerate Diagnostics strategy.  The Biospecimen Specialist is responsible for the acquisition and/or management of biospecimens and all associated sample/test data in compliance with local regulatory requirements, quality, business, and industry best practices/standards. **The Perfect Candidate:**  The perfect candidate is a highly motivated, organized, and solution\-driven team player with a meticulous attention to detail. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is committed to ensuring the highest quality, accuracy, and timeliness of biospecimen deliverables. The perfect candidate has strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to consistently follow complex protocols and excellent data handling capabilities. **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**  •**Biospecimen Acquisition \& Compliance:** Lead end\-to\-end biospecimen acquisition by gathering requirements, developing Scope of Work, reviewing and negotiating vendor Quotes and Material Transfer Agreements, and facilitating purchase requisitions, ensuring strict adherence to quality, compliance and industry best practices.  •Data Management \& LIMS Operations: Manage the complete biospecimen data lifecycle, including data transfer, review, transcription, quality/consistency checks, and resolution of discrepancies. Assume accountability for accurate data entry and execution of all data functions within validated Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).  •Project Oversight \& Stakeholder Engagement: Proactively monitor sample acquisition progress, identify and resolve issues, and assume responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of deliverables. Effectively interface with internal and external stakeholders to establish timelines and meet defined project goals.  •Documentation \& Regulatory Maintenance: Ensure continuous process compliance, including the accurate collection and maintenance of all required legal, regulatory, and ethics documentation according to established BAM procedures. **Must Haves:**  •Life science Bachelor's degree or equivalent, 1\-3 years relevant experience in sample acquisition, data management, biobankingOr, Life science Master's degree or equivalent, some experience in sample management, biobanking or related area  •Demonstrated hands\-on experience in biological sample collection, handling, processing, tracking, and biobanking workflows according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).  •Proven track record managing clinical trial operations, protocols, and deliverables from study start\-up to completion, adhering to defined project timelines, milestones, and scope.  •Strong working research.  •Solid understanding of data privacy requirements and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) governing patient consent, specimen handling, and clinical data integrity.  •Professional description: **Technical Supplier Manager: Process Design / Industrialization / DFX / Process Design/ Stewardship / Project Governance Operations Support / statistical process control (SPC)/ capability studies (Cpk) / measurement systems analysis / English / Deutsch**  **Background:**  At Roche Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life\-critical diagnostic solutions that empower healthcare professionals and patients around the globe. Within the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization, an essential pillar of our Global Instrument Network (GIN), we are seeking an experienced, driven Technical Supplier Manager (m/f/d).  In this role, you will be the vital technical bridge connecting our internal engineering and operations teams with our global network of contract manufacturing partners. You will take technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines. A primary pillar of your daily work is robust manufacturing process design, architecting, validating, and industrializing stable production processes both internally and across supplier sites. Alongside this focus, you will serve as the Technical Project Lead for Technical Transfers (External to External), leading international technology migrations, second\-sourcing ramp\-ups, and capacity expansions to ensure long\-term supply security and premium product quality.  **The Perfect Candidate** possesses a relevant technical degree and demonstrated expertise in statistical process control and project leadership, specifically in external technology transfers and line ramp\-ups. Additionally, strong knowledge of precision manufacturing technologies and production cost optimization is required.Tasks \& Responsibilities:  Manufacturing Process Design \& Industrialization (Core Activity)  • Process Architecture \& Development: Actively design, optimize, and industrialize robust manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across the external supply base  • Process Capability \& Validation: Define process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and establish process capability baselines (Cp/Cpk analysis, tolerance studies, and Gage R\&R)  • Design for Excellence (DfX): Partner closely with R\&D during early product development to embed Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability principles into component designs, preventing manufacturing bottlenecks and driving yield optimization  • Process Risk \& Mitigation: Lead process failure mode and effects analysis (pFMEA), establish poka\-yoke (error\-proofing) controls, and drive root\-cause investigations to engineer out process vulnerabilities  Technical Project Leadership \& External\-to\-External (E2E) Transfers  • Lead Technology Transfers: Steer end\-to\-end technical transfers between external contract manufacturers and suppliers (External\-to\-External), including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second\-source qualifications  • Project Governance \& Milestones: Establish qualification master plans (QMPs), define project schedules, align critical milestones, and report Collaborateur·trice commercial·e et événementiel à 80 %
============================================================

**Vous aimez le contact humain, l'organisation et les événements ? Vous avez un esprit commercial et une touche de créativité ? Alors cette opportunité est peut\-être faite pour vous !**

Situé dans un cadre exceptionnel au bord du lac de Neuchâtel, Le Camp à Vaumarcus accueille tout au long de l'année des groupes, des entreprises, des associations et des particuliers pour des séjours, des séminaires et différents événements.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personne dynamique, polyvalente et autonome pour assurer le suivi commercial de nos clients ainsi que participer au développement de notre communication et à l'organisation de nos événements.

**Vos missions**

**Gestion commerciale (60 %)**

* Traiter les demandes de renseignements et de réservations.
* Établir les offres et les contrats de location.
* Assurer le suivi des réservations et la confirmation des contrats.
* Conseiller et accompagner les clients tout au long du processus de réservation.
* Organiser et réaliser les visites des lieux avec les clients potentiels.
* Recherche de nouveaux clients et promotion des prestations du Camp.
* Assurer la coordination des informations entre les différents services.
* Préparer les dossiers d'accueil et assurer la remise des locaux aux groupes.
* Contrôler les locaux lors du départ des groupes.
* Assurer la séance d'information du lundi avec les clients.
* Assurer la permanence téléphonique et le traitement des demandes.
* Effectuer diverses tâches administratives.


**Communication et événementiel (20 %)**

* Participer à la conception, à l'organisation et à la coordination des événements du Camp (repas dégustation, repas de chasse, marché de Noël et autres événements).
* Participer à l'organisation et au suivi des séminaires et événements d'entreprises.
* Assurer la communication et la promotion des événements.
* Gérer et animer les réseaux sociaux (Facebook, Instagram et LinkedIn).
* Créer des contenus et des supports de communication (affiches, visuels, presse, etc.).
* Participer à la mise à jour du site internet.
* Participer à la coordination logistique et à la mise en place des événements.
* Élaborer et assurer le suivi des questionnaires de satisfaction.


**Votre profil**

* Formation commerciale, événementielle ou administrative.
* Aisance relationnelle et sens du service à la clientèle.
* Bonnes capacités organisationnelles et autonomie.
* Intérêt pour la communication et le marketing.
* Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et des réseaux sociaux.
* Sensibilité visuelle et intérêt pour la création de contenus visuels et de supports de communication.
* Esprit d'équipe et polyvalence.
* Flexibilité et disponibilité pour travailler les week\-ends (minimum 1x par mois).
* Excellente maîtrise du français. L'allemand et l'anglais sont des atouts.


**Nous vous offrons**

Nous vous proposons un poste varié et polyvalent au sein d'une structure à taille humaine, dans un cadre de travail agréable au bord du lac de Neuchâtel. Vous bénéficierez d'une activité diversifiée alliant commerce, relation clientèle, communication et événementiel, avec une certaine autonomie dans l'organisation et la réalisation de vos tâches, au sein d'une équipe dynamique et engagée.

**Conditions du poste**

* **Lieu de travail :** Le Camp, Vaumarcus (NE)
* **Taux d'activité :** 80 % (33 h 35 par semaine)
* **Entrée en fonction :** De suite, à convenir
* **Horaires :** Horaires adaptables selon les besoins de l'activité et des événements. Un week\-end de permanence par mois minimum, selon un planning établi à l'avance.

title: Technical Supplier Manager
description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a:**Technical Supplier Manager**At Roche Diagnostics, we develop and deliver life\-critical diagnostic solutions that support healthcare professionals and patients worldwide.As part of the Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization within the Global Instrument Network (GIN), you will play a key role in ensuring robust manufacturing processes, reliable supplier performance, and long\-term supply security.You will act as the technical interface between internal engineering and operations teams and international contract manufacturing partners. Your responsibilities include technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines, with a strong focus on manufacturing process design, validation, and industrialization.You will also lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers, second\-sourcing initiatives, and capacity expansions to ensure consistent product quality and reliable supply.**Your Responsibilities***Manufacturing Process Design \& Industrialization** Design, develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across external supplier sites.* Define and implement process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and process capability assessments, including Cp/Cpk, tolerance studies, and Gage R\&R.* Collaborate with R\&D during early product development to integrate Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability (DfX) principles, improve yields, and prevent manufacturing bottlenecks.* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks through pFMEA, poka\-yoke (error\-proofing), and structured root\-cause investigations.*Technical Project Leadership \& Technology Transfers** Lead external\-to\-external (E2E) technology transfers between contract manufacturers and suppliers, including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second\-source qualifications.* Develop qualification master plans (QMPs), coordinate project schedules and milestones, and provide transparent progress reporting to MSAT and GIN leadership.* Ensure technical alignment and effective change control between transferring and receiving supplier sites, Roche Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs.*Technical Supplier Management \& Operations Support** Monitor supplier manufacturing processes, technical KPIs, process stability, and component quality throughout the instrument lifecycle.* Lead technical investigations and sustainable corrective actions for component deviations and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), using methods such as 8D, Ishikawa, and 5\-Why.* Conduct technical supplier assessments and audits to support the qualification of new and existing manufacturing partners.* Manage supplier\-side engineering changes without specification changes, capacity expansions, and continuous production line stabilization initiatives.**Your Profile***Education \& Professional Experience** University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) or Higher Technical Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* At least 5–6 years of relevant industry experience in manufacturing process design, technical supplier management, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering, ideally within medical devices, in\-vitro diagnostics (IVD), pharmaceuticals, or precision high\-tech equipment.*Technical Expertise** Proven hands\-on experience in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and testing processes.* Strong knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies (Cp/Cpk), measurement systems analysis (MSA), and pFMEA.* Solid understanding of precision manufacturing technologies, such as injection molding, precision mechanics and machining, electronics assembly, and automated testing.* Understanding of manufacturing cost drivers and cycle time optimization.* Practical knowledge of ISO 13485, GMP/FDA regulations, process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), and formal change management procedures.*Project Management \& Collaboration** D j4id10469068jm j4it1145jm j4iy26jm

title: Head of Commercial Sales
description: Postulation : https://international-skating-union.ilucca.ch/recruitment/job-opportunities/9/job-offerThe RoleThe Head of Commercial Sales will define and lead the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, with overall accountability for sustainable revenue growth across sponsorship, strategic partnerships and new commercial opportunities. Reporting to the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer, the role will establish the ISU’s approach to market, set commercial priorities and revenue targets, and build a high-performing sales function capable of securing and growing high-value, multi-year partnerships.As the senior commercial sales lead, the role combines strategic leadership with direct responsibility for major business development. The successful candidate will personally originate and close complex opportunities, represent the ISU with C-suite decision-makers and ensure that commercial propositions reflect the full value of the ISU’s global events, disciplines, audiences and digital platforms.The Head of Commercial Sales will create the strategy, structures, processes and market relationships required to deliver ambitious short- and long-term revenue growth. While the role is primarily focused on new business, it will also provide senior oversight of partner value, renewals and the effective transition of signed agreements into delivery.Key ResponsibilitiesCommercial Strategy & Revenue Leadership:- Define and own the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, translating organisational priorities into a clear multi-year revenue plan.- Set annual revenue targets, sector priorities, market-development plans and performance measures, with accountability for delivery against agreed commercial objectives.- Lead the development of a diversified and sustainable commercial portfolio across sponsorship, partnerships and other revenue-generating opportunities.- Advise the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer and senior leadership on commercial opportunities, investment priorities, risks and market positioning.- Own sales forecasting, pipeline quality, pricing discipline and commercial reporting, ensuring accurate and timely visibility of performance.Business Development & Strategic Sales:- Personally originate, develop and close high-value, multi-year commercial agreements with global and regional brands.- Build and maintain a strong qualified pipeline by leveraging an established network and creating new relationships with brands, agencies and senior decision-makers.- Lead senior-level pitches, presentations and negotiations, taking responsibility for commercial terms, internal approvals and successful contract conclusion.- Prioritise and develop opportunities across strategic sectors including technology, AI and innovation, consumer electronics, financial services, travel, automotive, luxury, FMCG, health and wellness, and telecommunications.Commercial Proposition, Rights & Innovation: - Direct the development of compelling, insight-led commercial propositions aligned with partner objectives and the ISU’s strategic priorities.- Establish pricing principles and lead rights valuation, packaging and inventory management to maximise revenue while protecting long-term value.- Identify and develop new commercial assets and revenue platforms across events, digital, content, data, licensing, hospitality and fan engagement.- Ensure proposals are commercially robust, operationally deliverable and supported by a clear assessment of value, cost, risk and return.Functional Leadership & Sales Excellence:- Build and lead the commercial sales function, including employees, consultants, agencies and other external sales resources as required.- Create clear sales processes, governance, CRM discipline and performance standards to support effective prioritisation and execution.- Allocate opportunities and resources effectively, coach colleagues involved in commercial development and foster a high-performance, accountable culture.- Manage relevant sales budgets and external resources in line with agreed priorities and return expectations.Senior Stakeholder & Partner Leadership:- Represent the ISU in senior-level discussions with global brands, agencies, rights holders, event organisers and other strategic stakeholders.- Build trusted C-suite relationships with prospective and existing partners, positioning the ISU as an innovative and credible global partner.- Provide senior oversight of the transition from sale to delivery, ensuring commitments are clear, achievable and effectively handed over to activation and servicing teams.- Oversee renewal strategy for priority partners and intervene at senior level where required to protect value and long-term relationships.Cross-Functional & Organisational Leadership:- Work with marketing, communications, digital, events, broadcast, legal and finance colleagues to create integrated, deliverable and commercially sound solutions.- Partner with ISU leadership, Member Federations and event organisers to identify and unlock commercial opportunities across global events and year-round properties.- Champion a commercially focused culture and improve organisational understanding of the value, use and protection of ISU commercial rights. Market Intelligence, Governance & Performance:- Monitor sponsorship trends, competitor activity and relevant market developments to identify opportunities and maintain a differentiated proposition.- Provide clear monthly and quarterly reporting on revenue, pipeline, conversion, forecast accuracy, market activity and key risks.- Ensure sales activity and agreements comply with internal governance, delegated authority, legal requirements and the ISU’s ethical standards.- Use data, insight and post-deal evaluation to improve commercial decision-making, proposition development and sales performance.Expected profileEssential:- At least 10 years’ progressive experience in sponsorship sales, commercial partnerships, rights-holder business development or a comparable commercial discipline, including significant experience at senior leadership level.- Proven accountability for ambitious annual revenue targets and a strong record of originating, negotiating and closing high-value, multi-year international agreements.- Demonstrated experience defining and delivering a commercial sales strategy across multiple markets, sectors or properties.- Experience leading and developing employees, consultants, agencies or international sales resources, with the ability to create accountability and high performance.- Established network of senior brand, agency and commercial decision-makers, with the credibility to operate confidently at C-suite and board level.- Strong understanding of rights valuation, pricing, packaging, commercial contracting, forecasting and pipeline management.- Exceptional negotiation, presentation and influencing skills, together with sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.- International outlook and experience working across cultures, with readiness to travel regularly for meetings, events and industry engagements.- Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Desirable:- Senior commercial experience within an international sports federation, rights holder, major sporting event, media or entertainment organisation.- Experience developing new commercial assets and propositions across digital, content, data, licensing, hospitality and experiential platforms.- Existing senior relationships within one or more priority sectors, including technology, AI and innovation, financial services, automotive, travel, luxury, telecommunications or FMCG.- Knowledge of the Olympic Movement and the international sport ecosystem, including experience working with organising committees, Member Federations or major event organisers.- Additional language skills, particularly French, are an asset.

title: Lead - Apparel & Accessories Testing
description: In short- Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.- As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, quality, and performance.Your Mission- Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across quality, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.- Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.- Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.- Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.- Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation.- Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.- Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.Your Story- A strategic thinker with prior leadership experience and a coaching mindset, skilled at facilitating team development and maintaining high engagement in fast-paced or demanding environments.- A proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market. - Deep expertise in high-performance sports apparel and accessories, with a strong preference for candidates with experience in the Outdoor, Teamsport or Running categories.- You know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback. - You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams - You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.- You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service.- We are excited to hear from candidates from backgrounds, including but not limited to:Apparel Product Testing or Development User Experience Research (UXR) Biomechanics or Kinesiolog- You are willing to travel to conduct testing every 1-2 months within Europe and globally. You have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules. - Demonstrated experience conducting product testing directly with athletes, with a proven ability to translate Athlete feedback into actionable insights that drive apparel and accessories creation. - You bring commercial sports brand experience in apparel and accessories testing, coupled with the cross-functional expertise needed to partner effectively with Design, Development, and Materials teams. - Language: A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written. Proficiency or fluency in Italian is an advantage. Your TeamYou'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

title: Head of Commercial Sales
description: Postulation : https://international-skating-union.ilucca.ch/recruitment/job-opportunities/9/job-offerThe RoleThe Head of Commercial Sales will define and lead the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, with overall accountability for sustainable revenue growth across sponsorship, strategic partnerships and new commercial opportunities. Reporting to the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer, the role will establish the ISU’s approach to market, set commercial priorities and revenue targets, and build a high-performing sales function capable of securing and growing high-value, multi-year partnerships.As the senior commercial sales lead, the role combines strategic leadership with direct responsibility for major business development. The successful candidate will personally originate and close complex opportunities, represent the ISU with C-suite decision-makers and ensure that commercial propositions reflect the full value of the ISU’s global events, disciplines, audiences and digital platforms.The Head of Commercial Sales will create the strategy, structures, processes and market relationships required to deliver ambitious short- and long-term revenue growth. While the role is primarily focused on new business, it will also provide senior oversight of partner value, renewals and the effective transition of signed agreements into delivery.Key ResponsibilitiesCommercial Strategy & Revenue Leadership:- Define and own the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, translating organisational priorities into a clear multi-year revenue plan.- Set annual revenue targets, sector priorities, market-development plans and performance measures, with accountability for delivery against agreed commercial objectives.- Lead the development of a diversified and sustainable commercial portfolio across sponsorship, partnerships and other revenue-generating opportunities.- Advise the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer and senior leadership on commercial opportunities, investment priorities, risks and market positioning.- Own sales forecasting, pipeline quality, pricing discipline and commercial reporting, ensuring accurate and timely visibility of performance.Business Development & Strategic Sales:- Personally originate, develop and close high-value, multi-year commercial agreements with global and regional brands.- Build and maintain a strong qualified pipeline by leveraging an established network and creating new relationships with brands, agencies and senior decision-makers.- Lead senior-level pitches, presentations and negotiations, taking responsibility for commercial terms, internal approvals and successful contract conclusion.- Prioritise and develop opportunities across strategic sectors including technology, AI and innovation, consumer electronics, financial services, travel, automotive, luxury, FMCG, health and wellness, and telecommunications.Commercial Proposition, Rights & Innovation: - Direct the development of compelling, insight-led commercial propositions aligned with partner objectives and the ISU’s strategic priorities.- Establish pricing principles and lead rights valuation, packaging and inventory management to maximise revenue while protecting long-term value.- Identify and develop new commercial assets and revenue platforms across events, digital, content, data, licensing, hospitality and fan engagement.- Ensure proposals are commercially robust, operationally deliverable and supported by a clear assessment of value, cost, risk and return.Functional Leadership & Sales Excellence:- Build and lead the commercial sales function, including employees, consultants, agencies and other external sales resources as required.- Create clear sales processes, governance, CRM discipline and performance standards to support effective prioritisation and execution.- Allocate opportunities and resources effectively, coach colleagues involved in commercial development and foster a high-performance, accountable culture.- Manage relevant sales budgets and external resources in line with agreed priorities and return expectations.Senior Stakeholder & Partner Leadership:- Represent the ISU in senior-level discussions with global brands, agencies, rights holders, event organisers and other strategic stakeholders.- Build trusted C-suite relationships with prospective and existing partners, positioning the ISU as an innovative and credible global partner.- Provide senior oversight of the transition from sale to delivery, ensuring commitments are clear, achievable and effectively handed over to activation and servicing teams.- Oversee renewal strategy for priority partners and intervene at senior level where required to protect value and long-term relationships.Cross-Functional & Organisational Leadership:- Work with marketing, communications, digital, events, broadcast, legal and finance colleagues to create integrated, deliverable and commercially sound solutions.- Partner with ISU leadership, Member Federations and event organisers to identify and unlock commercial opportunities across global events and year-round properties.- Champion a commercially focused culture and improve organisational understanding of the value, use and protection of ISU commercial rights. Market Intelligence, Governance & Performance:- Monitor sponsorship trends, competitor activity and relevant market developments to identify opportunities and maintain a differentiated proposition.- Provide clear monthly and quarterly reporting on revenue, pipeline, conversion, forecast accuracy, market activity and key risks.- Ensure sales activity and agreements comply with internal governance, delegated authority, legal requirements and the ISU’s ethical standards.- Use data, insight and post-deal evaluation to improve commercial decision-making, proposition development and sales performance.Expected profileEssential:- At least 10 years’ progressive experience in sponsorship sales, commercial partnerships, rights-holder business development or a comparable commercial discipline, including significant experience at senior leadership level.- Proven accountability for ambitious annual revenue targets and a strong record of originating, negotiating and closing high-value, multi-year international agreements.- Demonstrated experience defining and delivering a commercial sales strategy across multiple markets, sectors or properties.- Experience leading and developing employees, consultants, agencies or international sales resources, with the ability to create accountability and high performance.- Established network of senior brand, agency and commercial decision-makers, with the credibility to operate confidently at C-suite and board level.- Strong understanding of rights valuation, pricing, packaging, commercial contracting, forecasting and pipeline management.- Exceptional negotiation, presentation and influencing skills, together with sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.- International outlook and experience working across cultures, with readiness to travel regularly for meetings, events and industry engagements.- Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.Desirable:- Senior commercial experience within an international sports federation, rights holder, major sporting event, media or entertainment organisation.- Experience developing new commercial assets and propositions across digital, content, data, licensing, hospitality and experiential platforms.- Existing senior relationships within one or more priority sectors, including technology, AI and innovation, financial services, automotive, travel, luxury, telecommunications or FMCG.- Knowledge of the Olympic Movement and the international sport ecosystem, including experience working with organising committees, Member Federations or major event organisers.- Additional language skills, particularly French, are an asset.

title: Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)--- (Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)=============================================================================***Shape the future of bioanalysis for innovative medicines*** **Celerion** is one of the world's leading bioanalytical contract research organizations and has been supporting pharmaceutical and biotech drug development programs around the world for more than 40 years.To strengthen our bioanalytical laboratory in the Ligand Binding Service Team in Fehraltorf / Zurich, we are looking for a**(Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator (100%)\***----------------------------------------------------------In this role, you will take scientific and operational ownership of regulated bioanalytical studies and method validations. You will serve as the primary client contact, lead study execution from planning through reporting, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality data to support drug development programs worldwide.\* This is a dual\-level posting. The hiring team will determine the final level and title of the role based on the skills, experience, and capabilities required for the level offered.### Main responsibilities**Study Leadership \& Scientific Oversight*** Lead and oversee GLP/GxP\-compliant bioanalytical studies and method validations within the Ligand Binding Services (LBS) department.* Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.* Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.* Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.* Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.**Client Management*** Serve as the primary scientific and operational contact for assigned clients.* Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.* Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.**Operational Excellence*** Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.* Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.* Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.* Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.**Additional Responsibilities for Senior\-Level Candidates*** Lead complex or strategic client programs.* Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.* Act as a subject matter expert for ligand\-binding and cell\-based assay technologies.* Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.### Our requirements* BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field* At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position* Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell\-based), preferably in an industry setting* Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards)* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills* Detail\-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail* Excellent computer and time management skills* Highly self\-motivated, reliable, and flexible, with a commitment to providing excellent service to clients.* Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions* Excellent English (written and spoken), good skills are advantageous* Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role is required for the senior position* Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis* Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients is advantageous### Your chanceWe provide an opportunity to assume work independently, secure long\-term employment, and enjoy a competitive salary.  Your workplace will be located within our state\-of\-the\-art equipped automated facilities in cantone Zurich as part of an international organization.  Additionally, you will experience the advantages of flexible working hours and experience the benefits of a medium\-sized company with flat organizational structure within a dynamic and international team.  Our benefits: extra holidays, company\-paid sickness and accident insurance, commuting allowance and access to \-Checks. Please send your complete application directly via our careers page: *Recruiting agencies: For this position, Celerion is not willing to take any unasked applications by recruiting offices. Thanks for your understanding.*![Celerion Switzerland AG]()* Celerion Switzerland AG  Allmendstrasse 32  8320 Fehraltorf*jidece5e86jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

title: Manager - Technology Risk Advisory – SAP Security and Authorizations (25318)
description: Location: Zurich, or GenevaWork Pattern Percentage: 80-100%Start Date: ImmediateJoin Deloitte Switzerland’s SAP Security and Authorization TeamSecure the digital core of enterprises through SAP security and authorization managementAbout the RoleAre you passionate about translating complex SAP security challenges into elegant, resilient solutions that safeguard critical business systems? At Deloitte Switzerland, within our SAP Security team in Technology & Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in helping organisations strengthen their SAP security posture and authorization controls. Your expertise will empower clients to manage complex security challenges in an increasingly digital and regulated environment, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and resilience.Finding the talent that makes Deloitte uniqueDay-to-day, you will lead SAP security and authorization transformation initiatives, design robust security frameworks, and provide expert guidance on managing access controls and security risks within SAP environments, notably SAP S/4HANA implementations. How you can make an impactManage the delivery of projects, actively engaging with clients and overlooking quality and performance of teams.Drive growth by expanding our SAP Security offering and on-boarding high-value clients.Lead strategic initiatives to help clients assess SAP security risks, define resilient security controls and frameworks, and establish good-practice security processes with long-term compliance roadmaps.Design comprehensive SAP security baselines and authorization concepts, including roles and Segregation of Duties rulesets for various SAP systems, such as SAP ECC and S/4HANA.Conduct comprehensive SAP security assessments and implement SAP cyber security controls aligned with industry frameworks (e.g. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).Implement solutions (e.g. SAP GRC, SAP Ariba, etc.) that optimize processes and deliver innovative solutions to complex SAP security challenges at our clients. Work with best-in-class AI solutions to deliver value to clients.Contribute to the further improvements of innovative AI and automation tools and assets that drive the future of SAP security and authorization transformation. Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to support go-to-market strategies and develop cutting-edge SAP security offerings.What you bring to succeed  You are proactive, adaptable, keen to grow and have strong interpersonal and communication skills, focused on building outstanding relationships with clients. You are able to manage end-to-end sales processes / “RFP” related dynamics for medium/high complexity clients. Experience in a leading Consulting firm will be considered a plus.Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in SAP Security and Authorizations, including authorization frameworks, role concept and design (attribute-based (ABAC) and role-based access controls (RBAC)), Segregation of Duties, and GRC technologies. Hands-on experience with SAP security solutions beyond SAP GRC is a plus. Proven expertise in implementing SAP S/4HANA, including business process mapping, technical configuration of authorizations, and Fiori. You have proven experience in Cyber Security Frameworks and Application Security, with hands-on expertise in managing SAP System Security (e.g. patch and vulnerability management, system parameters, connectivity, technical users, secure code etc). Experience with SAP Security Software and Tools is a plus.Fluent in English, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders. Additional languages, such as German or French, is a plus.What sets you apartRelevant certifications : CISM, SAP Certifications, CISSP, CISAExperience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) security, including identity and access management (IAM), API security, secure integration patterns, and cloud-native security controls. Knowledge of SAP BTP security best practices and threat modelling is a plus.You understand the operating models to be put into place for efficient day-to-day SAP security processes. Experience with near- and off-shore models is a plus.Demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence (AI), such as leveraging AI tools or solutions within risk, security, or SAP-related contexts (e.g., AI-driven access control analysis, intelligent risk assessment, automation of security controls).Coaching, team management and problem resolution skills are part of your strengths.Your Team Our SAP Security and Authorization team, part of the Controllership & Treasury team within Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of application security, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their digital transformation journeys.Meet our peopleWant to learn more about what it's really like to work at Deloitte? Hear directly from our Technology & Transformation team: Take off into a career without limits: In Technology & Transformation | Deloitte Switzerland.Benefits for you We believe in more than just work – we're committed to creating meaningful, inclusive experiences where you can thrive, both personally and professionally. From flexible working arrangements and continuous learning to comprehensive well-being support and opportunities to make a social impact, we invest in helping you grow. Explore our full benefits package here.Careers at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society.
